title: PaperScorer: How Predictable Is Paper Acceptance?

paragraphs.en: Automated research is largely evaluated by benchmark performance, but the value of research rarely reduces to a single score. Humans judge a work’s holistic contribution through peer review, which is hard to model because it is noisy and depends on many factors. However, what if, given only the paper, we could predict its peer-review decision directly? We introduce PaperScorer , a family of models that predict a paper’s accept or reject decision from its extracted text or page screenshots, training only on the decision after removing author identity and formatting shortcuts. Vision models are the most predictive (68% accuracy on ICLR papers and 77% on ML papers from arXiv), beating text-only and frontier reasoning models. Unlike plain text, page images retain figures, layout, and presentation. This signal is robust, surviving smaller models and even compressing the whole paper into a single image. But accurate predictions are not evenly spread. PaperScorer is strongest on the lowest and highest rated papers, while papers rated in the middle stay unpredictable for our models and frontier systems alike. Additionally, its confidence is calibrated, so its most confident predictions are also its most accurate. Overall, PaperScorer shows how much of the decision a paper carries on its own, marking a first step toward AI-driven research evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 自动化研究主要依据基准测试成绩来评估，但研究价值很少能归结为一个单一分数。 人类通过同行评审来判断一项工作的整体贡献，这种方式噪声大且依赖诸多因素，因而难以建模。 然而，如果仅凭论文本身，我们就能直接预测其同行评审的录用决定，会怎样呢？ 我们提出 PaperScorer，这是一系列模型，能够根据提取的文本或页面截图预测论文的被接收或被拒稿决定，训练时在去除作者身份和排版捷径后仅使用决定结果。 视觉模型最具预测力（在 ICLR 论文上准确率为 68%，在 arXiv 的机器学习论文上为 77%），超越了纯文本模型和前沿推理模型。 与纯文本不同，页面图像保留了图表、版面和呈现方式。 这一信号十分稳健，在更小的模型上依然有效，甚至将整篇论文压缩为单张图像后仍然如此。 但准确的预测并非均匀分布。 PaperScorer 在评分最低和最高的论文上表现最强，而对于评分居中的论文，无论我们的模型还是前沿系统都无法预测。 此外，其置信度经过校准，因此最有把握的预测同时也是最准确的预测。 总体而言，PaperScorer 展示了论文自身能够承载多大程度的录用决定，标志着迈向 AI 驱动研究评估的第一步。

paragraphs.en: Increasingly capable large language model (LLM) agents are beginning to automate research end to end, proposing ideas, running experiments, and interpreting the results to recursively self-improve ( Lu et al., 2024 ; Yamada et al., 2025 ; Si et al., 2026 ; Favaro and Clark, 2026 ) . This loop needs a way to judge whether a result is good, and the standard judge is a benchmark. Optimizing benchmarks has driven much of the field’s progress, from ImageNet in computer vision ( Deng et al., 2009 ) to MuJoCo in reinforcement learning ( Todorov et al., 2012 ) . Yet many contributions, such as findings or interpretability work, have no benchmark, and even where they exist, researchers disagree about which ones matter. This necessitates peer review.
paragraphs.zh: 能力日益增强的大语言模型（LLM）智能体正开始端到端地自动化科研，提出想法、运行实验并解释结果，以实现递归式自我改进（Lu et al., 2024；Yamada et al., 2025；Si et al., 2026；Favaro and Clark, 2026）。 这一循环需要一种判断结果好坏的方式，而标准的评判工具就是基准测试。 对基准测试的优化推动了该领域的大量进展，从计算机视觉中的 ImageNet（Deng et al., 2009）到强化学习中的 MuJoCo（Todorov et al., 2012）。 然而，许多贡献（例如研究发现或可解释性工作）并没有对应的基准测试，即便存在基准测试，研究者们对哪些基准测试重要也存在分歧。 这就需要同行评审。

sents.en: This necessitates peer review.
sents.zh: 这就需要同行评审。

paragraphs.en: However, peer review is noisy and poorly understood. A paper is typically judged by three or four reviewers and a meta-reviewer, whose assessments are combined into a final accept or reject decision ( Yacoby, 2022 ) . In the NeurIPS ’14 and ’21 consistency experiments, roughly half of papers accepted by one committee would not have been accepted by the other ( Beygelzimer et al., 2021 ) . AI tools now add to this complexity ( Biswas et al., 2026 ) , as up to 17% of reviews were materially edited by LLMs ( Liang et al., 2024 ) , and LLM-generated feedback led 27% of treated reviewers to revise their reviews ( Thakkar et al., 2026 ) . A final decision therefore mixes paper signal with noise from reviewer assignment, interpretation, aggregation, and now the AI tools involved. Before automated systems can judge research the way peer review does, we need to know how much of the decision the paper itself determines. This motivates a simple question:
paragraphs.zh: 然而，同行评审充满噪声，且人们对其理解甚少。 一篇论文通常由三四位审稿人和一位元审稿人评审，他们的评估被合并为最终的接收或拒稿决定（Yacoby, 2022）。 在 NeurIPS ’14 和 ’21 的一致性实验中，约有一半被其中一个委员会接收的论文不会被另一个委员会接收（Beygelzimer et al., 2021）。 AI 工具如今进一步增加了这种复杂性（Biswas et al., 2026）：多达 17% 的评审被大语言模型实质性修改过（Liang et al., 2024），且大语言模型生成的反馈促使 27% 的受处理审稿人修改了其评审意见（Thakkar et al., 2026）。 因此，最终决定混合了论文本身的信号，以及来自审稿人分配、解读、汇总，以及如今所涉 AI 工具的噪声。 在自动化系统能够像同行评审那样评判研究之前，我们需要知道论文本身能决定这一决定的多少部分。 这促使我们提出一个简单的问题：

sents.en: This motivates a simple question:
sents.zh: 这促使我们提出一个简单的问题：

paragraphs.en: From paper content alone, how predictable is the final decision?
paragraphs.zh: 仅凭论文内容，最终决策的可预测性有多高？

paragraphs.en: Measuring this signal requires more than fitting accept/reject labels. Without careful controls, a predictor can rely on shortcut signals rather than paper content ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) . Camera-ready formatting, author-identifying text, source-specific artifacts, and the natural majority-reject rate can all leak the label ( Jin et al., 2024 ) . Even after removing shortcuts, final decisions remain noisy, so a useful model should report uncertainty, separating confident cases from papers whose outcomes are not predictable from content alone.
paragraphs.zh: 衡量这一信号需要的不仅仅是拟合接受/拒绝标签。 如果缺乏仔细的对照，预测器可能会依赖捷径信号而非论文内容（Zhang et al., 2025a）。 终稿排版格式、可识别作者的信息、来源特有的痕迹以及自然的多数拒绝率都可能泄露标签（Jin et al., 2024）。 即使去除了捷径，最终决策仍然存在噪声，因此一个有用的模型应当报告不确定性，将有把握的案例与仅凭内容无法预测结果的论文区分开来。

sents.zh: 衡量这一信号需要的不仅仅是拟合接受/拒绝标签。

paragraphs.en: We introduce PaperScorer , a family of models that predicts binary acceptance decisions from anonymized papers. PaperScorer is trained on final outcomes rather than intermediate reviews or ratings, using anonymized datasets of machine learning (ML) papers. To test whether extracted text is sufficient, we compare two representations of each paper, markdown for text models and screenshots of each page for vision models. The text representation contains all text, including formulas and tables, but excludes figures, while vision preserves the full document. Our datasets contain fully anonymized papers from ICLR , which are openly hosted and shared on OpenReview, and from ML conferences on arXiv , all from ’20–’26 and balanced 50/50 accept/reject to avoid a majority-reject shortcut.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 PaperScorer，这是一系列从匿名化论文中预测二元接收决策的模型。 PaperScorer 基于最终结果而非中间评审意见或评分进行训练，使用的是机器学习（ML）论文的匿名化数据集。 为了检验提取出的文本是否足够，我们比较了每篇论文的两种表示形式：供文本模型使用的 markdown，以及供视觉模型使用的每一页的截图。 文本表示包含所有文本，包括公式和表格，但不包括插图，而视觉表示则保留了完整文档。 我们的数据集包含来自 ICLR 的完全匿名化的论文，这些论文在 OpenReview 上公开托管和共享，还包含来自 arXiv 上 ML 会议的论文，全部来自 ’20–’26 年，并按 50/50 平衡接收/拒稿，以避免偏向多数拒稿的捷径。

sents.en: We introduce PaperScorer , a family of models that predicts binary acceptance decisions from anonymized papers.
sents.zh: 我们提出 PaperScorer，这是一系列从匿名化论文中预测二元接收决策的模型。

sents.en: PaperScorer is trained on final outcomes rather than intermediate reviews or ratings, using anonymized datasets of machine learning (ML) papers.

sents.zh: 为了检验提取出的文本是否足够，我们比较了每篇论文的两种表示形式：供文本模型使用的 markdown，以及供视觉模型使用的每一页的截图。

sents.zh: 文本表示包含所有文本，包括公式和表格，但不包括插图，而视觉表示则保留了完整文档。

sents.en: Our datasets contain fully anonymized papers from ICLR , which are openly hosted and shared on OpenReview, and from ML conferences on arXiv , all from ’20–’26 and balanced 50/50 accept/reject to avoid a majority-reject shortcut.
sents.zh: 我们的数据集包含来自 ICLR 的完全匿名化的论文，这些论文在 OpenReview 上公开托管和共享，还包含来自 arXiv 上 ML 会议的论文，全部来自 ’20–’26 年，并按 50/50 平衡接收/拒稿，以避免偏向多数拒稿的捷径。

paragraphs.en: Our main empirical result is that paper content contains recoverable decision signal, but this signal is limited. Our top vision model, PaperScorer -Vision, achieves 68% accuracy on ICLR , improving over the best frontier baseline by 2.7% . On arXiv , arXiv -trained PaperScorer -Vision achieves 77% accuracy, improving over frontier baselines by 9.0% . Beyond binary decisions, PaperScorer emits a continuous acceptance estimate. This score ranks accepted above rejected papers across thresholds, and on ICLR , it aligns with reviewer ratings better than reviewer-trained baselines. After calibration on validation data, confidence matches accuracy on our test datasets, so at X % X\% confidence, accuracy is about X % X\% .
paragraphs.zh: 我们的主要实证结果是：论文内容包含可恢复的决策信号，但该信号是有限的。 我们的顶级视觉模型 PaperScorer-Vision 在 ICLR 上达到 68% 的准确率，比最佳前沿基线提高了 2.7%。 在 arXiv 上，基于 arXiv 训练的 PaperScorer-Vision 达到 77% 的准确率，比前沿基线提高了 9.0%。 除了二元决策之外，PaperScorer 还会输出一个连续的录用概率估计。 该分数在各种阈值下都能将录用论文排在拒稿论文之前，并且在 ICLR 上，它与审稿人评分的一致性优于以审稿人数据训练的基线。 在验证数据上进行校准后，置信度在我们的测试数据集上与准确率相符，即在 X% 置信度下，准确率约为 X%。

sents.zh: 我们的主要实证结果是：论文内容包含可恢复的决策信号，但该信号是有限的。

sents.en: Our top vision model, PaperScorer -Vision, achieves 68% accuracy on ICLR , improving over the best frontier baseline by 2.7% .
sents.zh: 我们的顶级视觉模型 PaperScorer-Vision 在 ICLR 上达到 68% 的准确率，比最佳前沿基线提高了 2.7%。

sents.en: After calibration on validation data, confidence matches accuracy on our test datasets, so at X % X\% confidence, accuracy is about X % X\% .
sents.zh: 在验证数据上进行校准后，置信度在我们的测试数据集上与准确率相符，即在 X% 置信度下，准确率约为 X%。

paragraphs.en: Our experiments isolate several factors underlying performance. First, PaperScorer achieves significantly higher accuracy with vision than with text on both datasets. Vision enables analysis of figures, layout, and full-document presentation, signal that our text extraction discards. Second, predictability is concentrated at the extremes of reviewer rating, but not symmetrically. Frontier models reliably flag only the lowest-rated papers, whereas PaperScorer is accurate on both low and high-rated papers. Across all evaluated models, however, accuracy remains near chance on papers with intermediate reviewer ratings, so for these papers the document alone gives our models little to go on. Third, performance improves with data scale but is largely invariant to model size or input resolution. A 3B model performs similarly to a 7B model, and compressing the whole paper into a single image only marginally degrades performance.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的实验分离出了影响性能的若干因素。 首先，在两个数据集上，PaperScorer 使用视觉输入时的准确率都显著高于使用文本输入时。 视觉输入使得对图表、版面以及整篇文档呈现方式的分析成为可能，而这些信号在我们的文本提取中被丢弃了。 其次，可预测性集中在审稿人评分的两端，但并不对称。 前沿模型只能可靠地标记出评分最低的论文，而 PaperScorer 在低分和高分论文上都能做到准确。 然而，在所有被评估的模型中，对于审稿人评分居中的论文，准确率仍接近随机猜测，因此对于这些论文，仅凭文档本身我们的模型几乎无从判断。 第三，性能随数据规模提升，但对模型大小或输入分辨率基本不敏感。 一个 3B 模型的表现与 7B 模型相近，而将整篇论文压缩成单张图像也只会使性能轻微下降。

sents.en: Our experiments isolate several factors underlying performance.
sents.zh: 我们的实验分离出了影响性能的若干因素。

sents.en: First, PaperScorer achieves significantly higher accuracy with vision than with text on both datasets.
sents.zh: 首先，在两个数据集上，PaperScorer 使用视觉输入时的准确率都显著高于使用文本输入时。

sents.en: Vision enables analysis of figures, layout, and full-document presentation, signal that our text extraction discards.
sents.zh: 视觉输入使得对图表、版面以及整篇文档呈现方式的分析成为可能，而这些信号在我们的文本提取中被丢弃了。

sents.en: Second, predictability is concentrated at the extremes of reviewer rating, but not symmetrically.
sents.zh: 其次，可预测性集中在审稿人评分的两端，但并不对称。

sents.en: Frontier models reliably flag only the lowest-rated papers, whereas PaperScorer is accurate on both low and high-rated papers.
sents.zh: 前沿模型只能可靠地标记出评分最低的论文，而 PaperScorer 在低分和高分论文上都能做到准确。

sents.en: Across all evaluated models, however, accuracy remains near chance on papers with intermediate reviewer ratings, so for these papers the document alone gives our models little to go on.
sents.zh: 然而，在所有被评估的模型中，对于审稿人评分居中的论文，准确率仍接近随机猜测，因此对于这些论文，仅凭文档本身我们的模型几乎无从判断。

sents.en: Third, performance improves with data scale but is largely invariant to model size or input resolution.
sents.zh: 第三，性能随数据规模提升，但对模型大小或输入分辨率基本不敏感。

sents.en: A 3B model performs similarly to a 7B model, and compressing the whole paper into a single image only marginally degrades performance.
sents.zh: 一个 3B 模型的表现与 7B 模型相近，而将整篇论文压缩成单张图像也只会使性能轻微下降。

paragraphs.en: In summary, PaperScorer is the strongest paper decision predictor in our study, because a large, carefully controlled dataset lets straightforward supervised fine-tuning deliver higher accuracy and calibrated confidence, concentrated on the clear accepts and rejects. This matters because automated research makes research faster to iterate on, so submission volumes ( Yang et al., 2026 ) and reviewer burden ( Adam, 2025 ) rise, while benchmark scores tell only part of a contribution’s story, which means evaluation must scale in a way that reflects human judgment. At only 7B parameters, PaperScorer is a first step that measures how much of the human decision the paper alone carries, shows through calibration when to trust that estimate, and already plugs into agentic reviewing and literature search ( Appendix K ).
paragraphs.zh: 总而言之，PaperScorer 是我们研究中最强的论文录用决策预测器，因为一个大规模且经过精心控制的数据集使得简单的监督微调就能带来更高的准确率和经过校准的置信度，且这些优势集中在明确的接收与拒稿案例上。 这一点之所以重要，是因为自动化研究使研究的迭代更快，因此投稿量（Yang et al., 2026）和审稿人负担（Adam, 2025）不断上升，而基准测试分数只能反映贡献的一部分，这意味着评估必须以反映人类判断的方式进行扩展。 PaperScorer 仅有 7B 参数，它是测量论文本身能够承载多少人类决策的第一步，通过校准展示了何时可以信任该估计，并且已经可以接入智能体审稿和文献检索（附录 K）。

paragraphs.en: This section describes the balanced ICLR and source-derived arXiv corpora with paired markdown and page screenshots, and the training recipes behind PaperScorer .
paragraphs.zh: 本节介绍包含配对 markdown 与页面截图的平衡 ICLR 语料库与源自 arXiv 的语料库，以及 PaperScorer 背后的训练方案。

paragraphs.en: PaperScorer uses two balanced, anonymous accept/reject sources, both split 85/5/10 across train, validation, and test, and we evaluate on the most recent years of each test split. ICLR contains 25K submissions from OpenReview, evaluated on ’25–’26. arXiv contains LaTeX-source-derived proceedings papers, evaluated on ’24–’26 to include biannual venues like ECCV. arXiv training uses a large 83K set ( arXiv ) and a smaller 25K set proportional to ICLR ( arXiv-m ). All datasets are balanced 50/50, and Figure 2 shows examples from both.
paragraphs.zh: PaperScorer 使用两个均衡且匿名的录用/拒稿来源，二者均按 85/5/10 划分为训练集、验证集和测试集，我们在每个测试划分中最近几年的数据上进行评估。 ICLR 包含来自 OpenReview 的 25K 篇投稿，在 ’25–’26 年上进行评估。arXiv 包含由 LaTeX 源文件提取的会议论文，在 ’24–’26 年上进行评估，以纳入像 ECCV 这样的两年一届的会议。arXiv 训练使用一个 83K 篇的大规模数据集（ arXiv ）和一个与 ICLR 成比例的 25K 篇的小规模数据集（ arXiv-m ）。 所有数据集均为 50/50 均衡，图 2 展示了来自两者的示例。

sents.en: ICLR contains 25K submissions from OpenReview, evaluated on ’25–’26. arXiv contains LaTeX-source-derived proceedings papers, evaluated on ’24–’26 to include biannual venues like ECCV. arXiv training uses a large 83K set ( arXiv ) and a smaller 25K set proportional to ICLR ( arXiv-m ).

paragraphs.en: A paper-decision dataset is useful only if the model sees the same evidence that a final decision maker could have seen. We therefore require three properties before a paper enters the corpus:

sents.en: A paper-decision dataset is useful only if the model sees the same evidence that a final decision maker could have seen.
sents.zh: 只有当模型能够看到最终决策者本可以看到的相同证据时，论文决策数据集才有用。

paragraphs.en: Anonymity. The exported artifact should not reveal authors, affiliations, acknowledgments, source repositories, or camera-ready status that would leak the final review outcome to the model.
paragraphs.zh: 匿名性。 导出的工件不应透露作者、单位、致谢、源代码仓库或最终定稿状态等会向模型泄露最终评审结果的信息。

sents.en: Anonymity.
sents.zh: 匿名性。

sents.en: The exported artifact should not reveal authors, affiliations, acknowledgments, source repositories, or camera-ready status that would leak the final review outcome to the model.
sents.zh: 导出的工件不应透露作者、单位、致谢、源代码仓库或最终定稿状态等会向模型泄露最终评审结果的信息。

paragraphs.en: Main-conference scope. Papers must be full main-conference submissions, excluding workshops, short papers, industry tracks, withdrawn records, and other items outside the target decision process.
paragraphs.zh: 主会议范围。 论文必须是主会议的正式完整投稿，不包括研讨会、短文、工业界赛道、已撤回的记录以及其他不属于目标决策流程的内容。

paragraphs.en: Consistent processing of accepts and rejects. Accept and reject artifacts should differ through natural paper content, not through formatting shortcuts, rendering, or availability cues.

paragraphs.en: Data sourcing. We build ICLR from OpenReview because ICLR releases both accepted and rejected submissions with review metadata. The challenge is obtaining the anonymized artifact rather than a post-review PDF. Across six recent years, latest-rebuttal PDFs give the best availability for anonymous artifacts ( Appendix B.2 ), although they can contain rebuttal-era revisions in the artifact itself. We therefore use ICLR ’20–’23, ’25, and ’26 and exclude ICLR ’24, where accepts are only camera-ready.
paragraphs.zh: 数据来源。 我们基于 OpenReview 构建 ICLR，因为 ICLR 同时公开被接收和被拒的投稿及其评审元数据。 难点在于获取匿名化的工件（artifact）而非评审后的 PDF。 在近六年中，最新反驳（rebuttal）阶段的 PDF 为匿名工件提供了最佳的可获得性（附录 B.2），尽管其中可能包含反驳阶段对工件本身的修订。 因此我们使用 ICLR ’20–’23、’25 和 ’26，并排除 ICLR ’24，因为该届只有被接收论文的最终定稿版（camera-ready）。

sents.zh: 数据来源。

sents.en: We build ICLR from OpenReview because ICLR releases both accepted and rejected submissions with review metadata.
sents.zh: 我们基于 OpenReview 构建 ICLR，因为 ICLR 同时公开被接收和被拒的投稿及其评审元数据。

sents.en: The challenge is obtaining the anonymized artifact rather than a post-review PDF.

paragraphs.en: ICLR is only one machine-learning venue, so we also build a LaTeX-source derived arXiv corpus for broader training and evaluation. arXiv does not provide reject labels, but title matches to conference proceedings provide high-precision accepted papers ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . We therefore define an implied reject as a LaTeX-compiling paper that uses a covered venue template, satisfies the main-conference filters, and does not appear in that venue’s proceedings. This gives a noisier but more diverse source whose accept class is high fidelity and whose reject class tests whether the learned decision boundary survives weak negative labels.
paragraphs.zh: ICLR只是一个机器学习会议，因此我们还基于LaTeX源码构建了一个arXiv语料库，用于更广泛的训练与评估。arXiv不提供拒稿标签，但通过标题与会议论文集的匹配可以得到高精度的已录用论文（Yang et al., 2026）。 因此，我们将“隐含拒稿”定义为：一篇可通过LaTeX编译、使用了所覆盖会议的模板、满足主会议筛选条件、但未出现在该会议论文集中的论文。 这提供了一个噪声更大但更多样化的数据来源，其中录用类保真度高，而拒稿类则检验学到的决策边界能否在弱负标签下依然有效。

paragraphs.en: We use arXiv as a testbed for two transfer questions. First, within arXiv , we ask whether diverse supervision improves classification on held-out arXiv papers, paying particular attention to accept recall because accepted papers have the strongest provenance. Second, across sources, we compare arXiv -trained models on the high-fidelity ICLR set and ICLR -trained models on arXiv . This isolates whether diversity improves generalization or whether clean same-source labels remain more valuable than a larger weakly labeled pool.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用arXiv作为测试平台来研究两个迁移问题。 首先，在arXiv内部，我们询问多样化监督是否能提升对留出arXiv论文的分类效果，并特别关注录用召回率，因为已录用论文具有最强的来源可靠性。 其次，跨数据源地，我们将arXiv训练的模型在高保真ICLR集合上进行比较，并将ICLR训练的模型在arXiv上进行比较。 这可以隔离出多样化是否能提升泛化能力，还是干净的同源标签仍然比更大的弱标注池更有价值。

paragraphs.en: Data filtering and normalization. ICLR is primarily filtered by year and artifact availability, then balanced within OpenReview year. arXiv requires more reconstruction. Starting from 434,579 ML arXiv papers, we pull 434,443 LaTeX source tarballs in bulk from arXiv’s requester-pays S3 feed and extract their .tex contents with NeMo Curator’s ArxivIterator / ArxivExtractor ( NVIDIA, 2024 ) . We then detect venue style files, compile anonymous review-mode PDFs, and remove residual identifiers. We drop non-main-conference, workshop, withdrawn, industry-track, and short-format papers. For arXiv , we additionally require a successful anonymous render, a references section, and between six and 30 main content pages to ensure consistency across papers. Full pipeline details for both sources are documented in Appendix B.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 数据过滤与规范化。 ICLR 主要按年份和制品可用性进行过滤，然后在 OpenReview 年份内做均衡。arXiv 则需要更多的重构处理。 从 434,579 篇 ML arXiv 论文出发，我们通过 arXiv 的按请求付费 S3 数据源批量拉取了 434,443 个 LaTeX 源文件压缩包，并使用 NeMo Curator 的 ArxivIterator / ArxivExtractor（NVIDIA, 2024）提取其 .tex 内容。 随后，我们检测会议风格文件，编译匿名审稿模式的 PDF，并移除残留的身份标识信息。 我们剔除非主会、workshop、撤稿、工业轨道以及短篇格式的论文。 对于 arXiv，我们额外要求成功完成匿名渲染、包含参考文献部分，且正文页数在 6 到 30 页之间，以保证各论文之间的一致性。 两个数据源的完整流程细节记录在附录 B.3 中。

paragraphs.en: The coverage plot in Figure 3 reflects this sampling choice. ICLR starts with 40K ICLR submissions and subsamples rejects to 25K while keeping the annual distribution. For arXiv , submission year is more nebulous: implied rejects have upload dates, while proceedings-matched accepts have conference years and post-review uploads. We therefore do not year-balance arXiv , and instead subsample 101,659 filtered papers to an 83,656 balanced set that keeps the starting venue distribution.
paragraphs.zh: 图 3 中的覆盖率图反映了这一采样选择。 ICLR 以 4 万份 ICLR 投稿为起点，将拒稿下采样至 2.5 万份，同时保持各年份的分布。 对于 arXiv，投稿年份则较为模糊：隐含的拒稿有上传日期，而与会议论文集匹配的录用论文则有会议年份和评审后的上传日期。 因此，我们不对 arXiv 进行年份均衡，而是将 101,659 篇过滤后的论文下采样为一个包含 83,656 篇论文的均衡集合，并保持最初的会议/期刊（venue）分布。

sents.en: The coverage plot in Figure 3 reflects this sampling choice.
sents.zh: 图 3 中的覆盖率图反映了这一采样选择。

paragraphs.en: Both sources pass through the same MinerU ( Wang et al., 2024 ) normalization before export. We remove headers, line-numbering asides, author-identifying spans, and all content in and after the references. Text models receive markdown with excluded regions omitted, while vision models receive page screenshots with the same regions whitened. Text inputs use the full markdown up to a pre-defined 24,480 24{,}480 max context length, while for vision, each page is rendered and downscaled to at most 1,003,520 1{,}003{,}520 pixels ( 1280 × 28 2 1280{\times}28^{2} ), roughly 1,240 1{,}240 vision tokens. A typical paper runs about ten pages (median 10 10 , up to 33 33 ), so the vision input averages roughly 12,420 12{,}420 tokens, about half the max context length. Accepted papers still contain more content, figures, and citations after cleanup, reflecting differences in content rather than artifact mismatches.
paragraphs.zh: 两种来源在导出前都经过相同的 MinerU（Wang et al., 2024）归一化处理。 我们移除页眉、行号旁注、标识作者身份的片段，以及参考文献及其之后的全部内容。 文本模型接收排除区域被省略的 markdown，而视觉模型接收相同区域被涂白的页面截图。 文本输入使用截断至预设最大上下文长度 24,480 24{,}480 的完整 markdown，而在视觉方面，每页被渲染并降采样至最多 1,003,520 1{,}003{,}520 像素（1280 × 28 2 1280{\times}28^{2}），约合 1,240 1{,}240 个视觉 token。 一篇典型论文约十页（中位数 10 10 ，最多 33 33 ），因此视觉输入平均约 12,420 12{,}420 个 token，约为最大上下文长度的一半。 被接收的论文在清理后仍包含更多内容、图表和引用，这反映的是内容上的差异而非产物不匹配。

paragraphs.en: Why balanced training and evaluation? Conference decisions are naturally imbalanced, so raw accuracy can reward a predictor that mostly rejects papers. Therefore, we use a balanced test set, whereby accuracy equally weights accept and reject recall. This still supports natural-rate interpretation: for samples drawn from the same curated domain, class-conditional recalls from a balanced test can be reweighted by the known accept prior. In Appendix F.1 , this predicts natural-rate accuracy to within a few percent on ICLR / arXiv .
paragraphs.zh: 为什么需要均衡的训练与评估？ 会议的录用决策天然是不均衡的，因此原始准确率可能会奖励一个主要拒稿的预测器。 因此，我们使用均衡的测试集，使准确率对录用召回率和拒稿召回率赋予相同的权重。 这仍然支持自然比例的解释：对于来自同一精选领域的样本，由均衡测试得到的各类条件召回率可以通过已知的录用先验进行重新加权。 在附录 F.1 中，该预测在 ICLR / arXiv 上将自然比例准确率的误差控制在几个百分点以内。

sents.en: In Appendix F.1 , this predicts natural-rate accuracy to within a few percent on ICLR / arXiv .
sents.zh: 在附录 F.1 中，该预测在 ICLR / arXiv 上将自然比例准确率的误差控制在几个百分点以内。

paragraphs.en: The training prior is a separate choice. Natural-rate training matches the conference base rate, but the native decision rule then predicts rejection too often, since rejects are the majority class. Table 1 summarizes this as the gap between accept and reject recall. Natural-rate ICLR and arXiv models predict rejection far more often than acceptance under their native threshold, and tuning the threshold on validation data can shift it too far the other way. Balanced-trained models are closer to zero, so we use balanced training for the headline PaperScorer models. This removes the excess rejection predictions without per-dataset threshold tuning.
paragraphs.zh: 训练先验是一个独立的选择。 自然比率训练与会议基准比率相匹配，但原生决策规则随后会过于频繁地预测拒绝，因为拒绝是多数类别。 表 1 将其概括为接受召回率与拒绝召回率之间的差距。 自然比率的 ICLR 和 arXiv 模型在其原生阈值下预测拒绝的频率远高于预测接受的频率，而在验证数据上调整阈值又可能使其偏向另一个极端。 平衡训练的模型更接近于零，因此我们对主要的 PaperScorer 模型采用平衡训练。 这消除了过多的拒绝预测，而无需针对每个数据集进行阈值调整。

paragraphs.en: Chosen models. We use Qwen2.5 text and Qwen2.5-VL vision backbones ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Bai et al., 2025 ) because our original deployment target was ICLR , and Qwen2.5 is the latest Qwen generation that plausibly predates public ICLR ’25 decisions (text in December ’24, VL on January 26, ’25). This makes ICLR a clean deployment setting by the same cutoff logic, while later Qwen3/3.5 models are more likely to have seen those results; arXiv was added later and did not drive backbone selection. We also retrain a Qwen3 text backbone on ICLR and find that swapping the base model moves accuracy little ( Appendix E ).
paragraphs.zh: 所选模型。 我们使用 Qwen2.5 文本和 Qwen2.5-VL 视觉骨干网络（Yang et al., 2024；Bai et al., 2025），因为我们最初的部署目标是 ICLR，而 Qwen2.5 是最新一代 Qwen，且很可能早于 ICLR '25 的公开评审结果（文本模型于 2024 年 12 月发布，VL 模型于 2025 年 1 月 26 日发布）。 按照同样的时间截点逻辑，这使得 ICLR 成为一个干净的部署场景，而较新的 Qwen3/3.5 模型则更有可能已经见过这些结果；arXiv 是后来加入的，并未影响骨干网络的选择。 我们还在 ICLR 上对 Qwen3 文本骨干网络进行了重新训练，发现更换基础模型对准确率的影响很小（附录 E）。

sents.zh: 按照同样的时间截点逻辑，这使得 ICLR 成为一个干净的部署场景，而较新的 Qwen3/3.5 模型则更有可能已经见过这些结果；arXiv 是后来加入的，并未影响骨干网络的选择。

sents.en: We also retrain a Qwen3 text backbone on ICLR and find that swapping the base model moves accuracy little ( Appendix E ).
sents.zh: 我们还在 ICLR 上对 Qwen3 文本骨干网络进行了重新训练，发现更换基础模型对准确率的影响很小（附录 E）。

paragraphs.en: Our main comparison is against DeepReview-7B/14B ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) (trained through ICLR ’24), Gemini-3.1-Pro (January ’25 cutoff), and GPT-5.5 (December ’25 cutoff) reasoning baselines. GPT-5.5’s cutoff postdates the public release of ICLR ’25 decisions, so we probe it for memorization directly ( Appendix D ). It recognizes many of our test papers, but the decisions it claims to recall are not reliable. Once its accept bias is accounted for, they are at chance. It also cannot regenerate abstracts from titles (ROUGE-L ( Lin, 2004 ) at noise level), and its accuracy on the papers it recognizes matches its accuracy on those it does not, including on ICLR ’25. These probes provide no clear evidence that recalled acceptance decisions explain its baseline performance.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的主要比较对象是 DeepReview-7B/14B（Zhu et al., 2025）（训练数据截止至 ICLR '24）、Gemini-3.1-Pro（截止至 2025 年 1 月）以及 GPT-5.5（截止至 2025 年 12 月）等推理基线。 GPT-5.5 的训练截止时间晚于 ICLR '25 决定的公开发布，因此我们直接探测其是否存在记忆（附录 D）。 它能识别出我们的许多测试论文，但它声称回忆起的决定并不可靠。 在考虑其录用偏差后，这些决定处于随机水平。 它也无法根据标题重新生成摘要（ROUGE-L（Lin, 2004）得分与噪声水平相当），并且它在识别出的论文上的准确率与在未识别出的论文上的准确率相当，包括 ICLR '25 的论文在内。 这些探测并未提供明确证据表明回忆出的录用决定可以解释其基线表现。

paragraphs.en: Baseline Prompting. For main results, DeepReview runs in its native Standard Mode with four simulated reviewers, self-verification, and a meta-review decision. Gemini/GPT baselines use one venue-generic AI-Scientist-style prompt ( Lu et al., 2024 ; Yamada et al., 2025 ) that requests a 1–10 rating and an Accept/Reject decision. Mini and large frontier variants run at high reasoning effort. The generated decision is the default hard label, and the rating is a ranking score, not a probability. Qwen rows use the answer-only supervised fine-tuning (SFT) prompt or the reasoning reinforcement-learning (RL) prompt ( Appendix H.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 基线提示。 就主要结果而言，DeepReview 以其原生的标准模式运行，包含四个模拟评审、自我验证以及元评审决策。 Gemini/GPT 基线使用一个通用于各会议的 AI-Scientist 风格提示（Lu et al., 2024；Yamada et al., 2025），该提示要求给出 1–10 的评分以及接受/拒绝的决策。 Mini 和大型前沿变体均以高推理力度运行。 生成的决策是默认的硬标签，评分则用作排序分数，而非概率。 Qwen 行使用仅答案的监督微调（SFT）提示或推理强化学习（RL）提示（附录 H.1）。

paragraphs.en: We also evaluate frontier coding-agent harnesses with the same rating-plus-decision task. Each Codex or Claude Code run receives an isolated paper workspace with stripped markdown, page screenshots, instructions, and a schema validator that enforces a well-formed PREDICTIONS.json ; we log the full trajectory in session.jsonl . Agents run at the same high reasoning effort, inspect text and images selectively, and stay siloed without internet (prompt and layout in Appendix K.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们还用同样的“评分加决策”任务评估了前沿编码智能体框架。 每次 Codex 或 Claude Code 运行都会获得一个独立的论文工作区，其中包含去除 markdown 格式的文本、页面截图、指令，以及一个强制生成格式合法的 PREDICTIONS.json 的模式校验器；我们将完整轨迹记录在 session.jsonl 中。 智能体以同样的高推理强度运行，选择性地查看文本和图像，并且保持隔离、不联网（提示词和布局见附录 K.3）。

paragraphs.en: Baseline Correction Measures. Under the base prompt, several models strongly favor one decision class. We also tested more critical prompt variants, but bringing predicted acceptance rates closer to 50% did not reliably improve accuracy. We therefore retain the base prompt, the same one used to start SFT/RL training, for the main comparisons. These base prompts and their critical variants are defined in Appendix H.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 基线校正措施。 在基础提示下，多个模型强烈偏向某一个决策类别。 我们还测试了更严格的提示变体，但使预测接受率更接近 50% 并未能可靠地提升准确率。 因此，我们在主要比较中保留基础提示，即用于启动 SFT/RL 训练的同一提示。 这些基础提示及其严格变体定义于附录 H.3。

paragraphs.en: For each baseline, we also tune a threshold on its score using a small held-out sample of papers, and use the thresholded score as the hard label when it improves accuracy. Out-of-the-box thresholds are skewed: under its default threshold, GPT predicts rejection much more often than acceptance, and Gemini leans the same way, though less strongly. Yet both still show relatively high AUC, suggesting the predicted rating is well-ordered while the chosen decision threshold is biased. Calibrating the threshold generally helps baseline numbers, in agreement with the findings of Lu et al. (2024) .
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个基线，我们还使用一小部分留出的论文样本对其分数调整阈值，并在能提升准确率时将阈值化后的分数作为硬标签。 开箱即用的阈值是有偏的：在默认阈值下，GPT 预测拒稿的频率远高于接收，Gemini 也倾向于同样的方向，只是程度较轻。 然而两者仍表现出相对较高的 AUC，这表明预测的评分排序良好，而所选的决策阈值存在偏差。 校准阈值通常有助于改善基线结果，这与 Lu et al. (2024) 的发现一致。

paragraphs.en: We first define our metrics ( Section 4.1 ), then set a simple paper features baseline ( Section 4.2 ), and finally report main results against prompting and coding-agent baselines ( Section 4.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先定义评估指标（第 4.1 节），然后设定一个简单的论文特征基线（第 4.2 节），最后报告针对提示基线和编码智能体基线的主要结果（第 4.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: Each paper has a true decision z ∈ 𝒵 z\in\mathcal{Z} , and each system produces a hard prediction z ^ ∈ 𝒵 \hat{z}\in\mathcal{Z} and an accept score s ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] s\in[0,1] , where higher means more likely to be accepted. AUC evaluates each system’s ranking without requiring its scores to represent calibrated probabilities. paragraphs.en: Our primary metrics ask whether a system both makes the right binary decision and ranks accepted papers above rejected papers. The goal is to design a predictor that makes human-like decisions while producing a score that orders papers the way peer review does. Accuracy tests whether predictions match final decisions without hiding accept/reject collapse, while AUC tests whether accepted papers receive higher scores than rejected papers independent of a fixed threshold. This matters because the same model may be used on conferences or years outside its training distribution, where post-hoc threshold tuning may not be available. Secondary diagnostics separate class bias from rating alignment and calibration.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的主要指标考察一个系统是否既能做出正确的二元决策，又能将被接收的论文排在被拒绝的论文之上。 目标是设计一个预测器，使其在做出类似人类决策的同时，产生一个能以同行评审方式对论文排序的分数。 准确率检验预测是否与最终决策相符，且不会掩盖接收/拒绝失衡问题，而 AUC 则检验被接收的论文是否在固定阈值无关的情况下获得比被拒绝论文更高的分数。 这一点很重要，因为同一个模型可能会被用于其训练分布之外的会议或年份，而在这种情况下可能无法进行事后阈值调整。 次要诊断将类别偏差与评分一致性和校准区分开来。

paragraphs.en: Before training any large model, we ask how much of the accept/reject decision is recoverable from simple, hand-crafted features. We fit two full-data logistic-regression models, one on ICLR and one on arXiv , using paper features such as length, references, math notation, topic terms, and rhetorical counts. The models exclude source identifiers, venue labels, ratings, citations, author names, and body-page counts, since page metadata is not comparable between the ICLR and arXiv text exports. These simple models reach 61.1% accuracy on ICLR and 62.5% on arXiv . Their coefficients reveal which readily measured paper features are associated with acceptance. Figure 4 shows that accept features generally have to do with paper length, references, and figures, while reject features are more lexical (full inventory in Appendix C ).
paragraphs.zh: 在训练任何大模型之前，我们首先探究：仅凭简单的手工特征能在多大程度上还原录用/拒稿的决策。 我们分别针对 ICLR 与 arXiv 的全量数据拟合了两个逻辑回归模型，使用的论文特征包括篇幅、参考文献、数学符号、主题词以及修辞计数。 这些模型不使用来源标识、会议/期刊标签、评分、引用数、作者姓名以及正文页数，因为 ICLR 与 arXiv 文本导出版本之间的页码元数据并不可比。 这些简单模型在 ICLR 上达到 61.1% 的准确率，在 arXiv 上达到 62.5% 的准确率。 模型系数揭示了哪些易于测量的论文特征与录用相关。 图 4 表明，录用相关特征通常与论文篇幅、参考文献和图表有关，而拒稿相关特征则更多体现在词汇层面（完整清单见附录 C）。

paragraphs.en: Baseline performance. We compare base Qwen instruct models, mini and large frontier Gemini/GPT reasoning models, decision models, coding agents, and DeepReview. Untuned Qwen2.5 predicts Accept for 97–99% of papers ( Appendix H.3 ). Smaller high-reasoning models are also skewed natively, with Gemini-3-Flash accepting almost every paper and GPT-5.4-Mini rejecting almost every paper. Large frontier systems are more accurate and run at high reasoning (median ∼ \sim 2,000 reasoning tokens/request; Table H.2 ), but their accept/reject recalls are skewed. Gemini-3.1-Pro accepts only 30–34% of papers in three of four settings, while GPT-5.5 swings between accepting 39% and 74%.
paragraphs.zh: 基线性能。 我们比较了基础版 Qwen 指令模型、小型和大型前沿 Gemini/GPT 推理模型、决策模型、编码智能体以及 DeepReview。 未调优的 Qwen2.5 对 97–99% 的论文预测为接收（附录 H.3）。 较小的高推理模型本身也存在偏斜，Gemini-3-Flash 几乎接收每篇论文，而 GPT-5.4-Mini 几乎拒绝每篇论文。 大型前沿系统更为准确，并以高推理强度运行（每个请求的中位数约 2,000 个推理 token；表 H.2），但其接收/拒绝的召回率存在偏斜。 Gemini-3.1-Pro 在四个设置中的三个里仅接收 30–34% 的论文，而 GPT-5.5 则在接收 39% 和 74% 之间波动。

sents.en: Baseline performance.
sents.zh: 基线性能。

paragraphs.en: The coding-agent rows test whether interactive access to both modalities changes this pattern. While Claude Code has the strongest rating correlation and the agents have among the strongest AUCs in the baseline block, their Acc is lower than the best non-agent frontier baselines. Like Jev, coding agents can rank papers in a way that agrees with reviewer ratings, but still turn that ranking into skewed accept/reject decisions. DeepReview generates review-style judgments and a meta-review decision; its 14B model improves over 7B but still trails the best frontier model and PaperScorer .
paragraphs.zh: 编程智能体（coding-agent）行检验的是：同时交互式访问这两种模态是否会改变这一模式。 虽然 Claude Code 具有最强的评分相关性，且这些智能体在基线板块中拥有几乎最强的 AUC，但它们的 Acc 仍低于最佳的非智能体前沿基线。 与 Jev 类似，编程智能体能够以与评审评分相一致的方式对论文进行排序，但仍会将该排序转化为有偏颇的接收/拒稿决策。 DeepReview 生成评审式的判断和元评审决策；其 14B 模型优于 7B 模型，但仍落后于最佳的前沿模型和 PaperScorer。

paragraphs.en: Binary SFT recovers a stronger decision signal. The central result in Table 3 is that direct accept/reject supervision gives the strongest decision predictor and ranking signal. On ICLR , PaperScorer -Vision reaches 68.3 68.3 Acc, 2.7 % 2.7\% ahead of the best frontier vision model, Gemini-3-Flash. On arXiv , the matched arXiv -trained PaperScorer -Vision reaches 77.5 77.5 , a larger 9.0 % 9.0\% ahead of the best frontier baseline. On both datasets, PaperScorer -Vision significantly beats both large frontier models in Acc and AUC (one-sided paired bootstrap, p < .05 p<.05 ; Appendix J ). These gains are not a threshold artifact, since PaperScorer -Vision keeps accept and reject recall balanced, while the frontier systems rank papers well but natively skew their decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 二元SFT能恢复出更强的决策信号。 表3的核心结果是：直接的接受/拒绝监督能给出最强的决策预测器和排序信号。 在ICLR上，PaperScorer-Vision达到68.3 68.3的准确率，比最佳前沿视觉模型Gemini-3-Flash高出2.7% 2.7\%。 在arXiv上，与之匹配的arXiv训练版PaperScorer-Vision达到77.5 77.5，比最佳前沿基线高出9.0% 9.0\%，领先幅度更大。 在两个数据集上，PaperScorer-Vision在准确率和AUC上都显著优于两个大型前沿模型（单侧配对自助检验，p < .05 p<.05；附录J）。 这些提升并非阈值带来的假象，因为PaperScorer-Vision保持接受与拒绝召回率的平衡，而前沿系统虽能对论文进行良好排序，但其决策本身存在偏斜。

sents.en: Binary SFT recovers a stronger decision signal.
sents.zh: 二元SFT能恢复出更强的决策信号。

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 shows that the modality and method ordering is stable across years, with PaperScorer -Vision best in every matched-source year, prompting intermediate, and RL weaker. These results indicate that papers carry recoverable decision signal, although learning that signal through long reasoning traces is difficult with only a single, noisy accept/reject bit as reward. Supervising directly on the final decision works better, and vision keeps the layout and presentation cues that a markdown extract would strip.
paragraphs.zh: 图5显示，模态和方法的排序在各年份之间保持稳定，在所有匹配来源的年份中，PaperScorer-Vision 表现最佳，提示（prompting）居中，而 RL 较弱。 这些结果表明，论文中蕴含可恢复的决策信号，尽管仅凭单个嘈杂的接收/拒绝比特作为奖励，通过长推理轨迹学习该信号是困难的。 直接在最终决策上进行监督效果更好，且视觉模态保留了纯 markdown 提取会丢失的版式和呈现线索。

sents.en: Supervising directly on the final decision works better, and vision keeps the layout and presentation cues that a markdown extract would strip.
sents.zh: 直接在最终决策上进行监督效果更好，且视觉模态保留了纯 markdown 提取会丢失的版式和呈现线索。

paragraphs.en: Accuracy is not constant over time, and Acc and AUC drop sharply from ’25 to ’26 across PaperScorer , frontier models, and DeepReview, suggesting a shared change in the evaluation distribution. The early-cycle arXiv ’26 slice is also small, with 198 test papers from AAAI, CVPR, and ICLR ’26. Each cycle also introduces new methods, benchmarks, and reviewer norms that reset what counts as a strong paper, so some recalibration is unavoidable for any predictor whose training pool is more than a year stale. Training only through ’25 transfers poorly to ’26 ( Appendix F.2 ), so we fold ’26 into training and expect any deployed predictor to be periodically retrained as new conferences land.
paragraphs.zh: 准确率并非随时间保持恒定，在 PaperScorer、前沿模型和 DeepReview 上，从 ’25 到 ’26 的 Acc 和 AUC 都急剧下降，这表明评估分布发生了共同的变化。 处于周期早期的 arXiv ’26 切片规模也较小，仅包含来自 AAAI、CVPR 和 ICLR ’26 的 198 篇测试论文。 每个周期还会引入新方法、新基准和新的审稿规范，从而重新定义什么样的论文才算优秀论文，因此对于任何训练数据已超过一年未更新的预测器来说，某种程度的重新校准都不可避免。 仅用截至 ’25 的数据训练在 ’26 上迁移效果不佳（附录 F.2），因此我们将 ’26 的数据并入训练，并期望任何已部署的预测器随着新会议论文的发布被定期重新训练。

paragraphs.en: Beyond hard decisions, both PaperScorer -Text and PaperScorer -Vision reach top AUC on both datasets, ranking accepts above rejects regardless of threshold. The score also tracks human ratings; on ICLR , PaperScorer -Vision’s p accept p_{\mathrm{accept}} correlates with reviewer ratings more closely than DeepReview and frontier baselines, despite training only on final decisions. arXiv ratings are sparser ( 292 292 / ∼ \sim 1,415 1{,}415 test papers, skewed toward NeurIPS and ICLR accepts); on that biased subset coding agents correlate with ratings better than PaperScorer but still make worse decisions, so correlation with reviewer ratings does not convert into correct accept/reject calls.
paragraphs.zh: 除了做出困难决策之外，PaperScorer-Text 和 PaperScorer-Vision 在两个数据集上都达到了最高的 AUC，无论阈值如何，都能把录用排在拒稿之前。 该分数还能追踪人类评分；在 ICLR 上，尽管只在最终决策上训练，PaperScorer-Vision 的 p_accept p_{\mathrm{accept}} 与审稿人评分的相关性比 DeepReview 和前沿基线更紧密。arXiv 评分更为稀疏（292 292 / 约 \sim 1,415 1{,}415 篇测试论文，且偏向 NeurIPS 和 ICLR 的录用论文）；在这一有偏子集上，编码智能体与评分的相关性优于 PaperScorer，但决策仍更差，因此与审稿人评分的相关并不能转化为正确的录用/拒稿判断。

paragraphs.en: Model and data scale. Model scale changes decision accuracy only modestly once the SFT objective is fixed (Figure 6 a). Relative to matched 7B checkpoints, 3B and 14B variants barely move Acc, with no consistent direction across modality or source. A paired 95% bootstrap CI reveals that nearly every change in Acc is statistically insignificant (shaded in Figure 6(a) ). Vision is similarly competitive at smaller scale, so in Figure 6 b the largest arXiv Acc gain comes from data scale rather than parameter scale.
paragraphs.zh: 模型与数据规模。 在 SFT 目标固定的情况下，模型规模对决策准确率的影响较为有限（图 6 a）。 相对于参数量匹配的 7B 检查点，3B 与 14B 变体几乎不改变 Acc，且在不同模态或来源上没有一致的方向。 配对 95% 自助法置信区间（bootstrap CI）表明，Acc 的几乎所有变化在统计上都不显著（图 6(a) 中的阴影部分）。 视觉在较小规模下同样具有竞争力，因此在图 6 b 中，arXiv 上最大的 Acc 提升来自数据规模而非参数规模。

sents.en: Model and data scale.
sents.zh: 模型与数据规模。

paragraphs.en: For ICLR , we vary dataset size from 50% to 75% of the full pool. For arXiv , the arXiv-m and arXiv sets give us a 3.4 × \times multiple. More data helps for both datasets, and Figure 6 b shows that the dominant arXiv gain is data scale, not parameter scale, as the curve climbs steeply from arXiv-m to arXiv , well past the spread of the 3B/7B/14B parameter sweep. ICLR is much smaller, so taking 50% and 75% of this population compresses the visible slope, and the curves should not be read as comparable in absolute terms.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 ICLR，我们将数据集规模从完整数据池的 50% 变化到 75%。 对于 arXiv，arXiv-m 和 arXiv 两个数据集为我们提供了 3.4 × \times 倍的变化幅度。 更多的数据对两个数据集都有帮助，且图 6b 表明 arXiv 上的主要收益来自数据规模而非参数规模，因为曲线从 arXiv-m 到 arXiv 陡峭攀升，远超 3B/7B/14B 参数扫描的波动范围。 ICLR 的规模要小得多，因此取该数据总量的 50% 和 75% 会压缩可见的斜率，这些曲线不应被解读为在绝对意义上具有可比性。

paragraphs.en: Vision is strongest. It improves over text in the average ICLR / arXiv view (Figure 7 ) and in almost every dataset-specific comparison ( Table J.2 ). For PaperScorer , the Vision row beats its Text row on both datasets, and a paired bootstrap confirms the gain ( p = .012 p=.012 and .005 .005 after Holm–Bonferroni correction ( Abdi, 2010 ) ). For the frontier families, the vision–text gaps are small and none is significant once their decisions are thresholded ( Appendix J ). Screenshots preserve complete figures and tables, equation layout, and visual polish, all of which markdown extraction discards.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉表现最强。 在 ICLR / arXiv 平均视图（图 7）以及几乎所有针对特定数据集的对比（表 J.2）中，它都优于文本。 对于 PaperScorer，Vision 行在两个数据集上都胜过其 Text 行，且配对自助法检验证实了这一提升（经 Holm–Bonferroni 校正（Abdi, 2010）后 p = .012 和 .005）。 对于前沿模型家族，视觉与文本之间的差距很小，且在对其决策进行阈值化处理后，没有一个差距是显著的（附录 J）。 截图保留了完整的图表、公式排版和视觉美化效果，而这些都会在 markdown 提取中丢失。

paragraphs.en: Second, the signal largely survives heavy compression, since tiling all ten PaperScorer -Vision pages into a single 2380 × \times 1512 image cuts vision tokens by about 63 % 63\% (roughly 12,420 12{,}420 to 4,590 4{,}590 ), and only drops performance on ICLR by 2.2% (Table 4 ), a small change relative to the > 60 % >60\% token cut.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，该信号在很大程度上能够在高压缩率下保留下来，因为将 PaperScorer-Vision 的全部十页拼贴成一张 2380 × \times 1512 的图像可使视觉 token 减少约 63 % 63\%（大致从 12,420 12{,}420 减至 4,590 4{,}590），而在 ICLR 上的性能仅下降 2.2%（表 4），相对于 > 60 % >60\% 的 token 削减幅度而言这是一个很小的变化。

paragraphs.en: To investigate vision’s consistent advantage and the small cost of compression, we asked the base VL backbone to perform OCR on each input. On per-page screenshots it recovers ∼ 80 % {\sim}80\% of the content verbatim against the markdown extract. On the compressed panel, OCR retention drops to ∼ 30 % {\sim}30\% . Compression sharply reduces recoverable text while preserving layout, figure placement, and overall visual presentation. Prior work supports this direction, as diagram count and quality correlate with citations ( Marshall et al., 2021 ) , and paper organization shapes peer-review outcomes ( Jung et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 为了研究视觉输入的持续优势以及压缩带来的较小代价，我们让基础视觉语言骨干模型对每个输入执行 OCR。 在逐页截图上，它能对照 markdown 提取文本逐字恢复约 80% 的内容。 在压缩面板上，OCR 保留率降至约 30%。 压缩在保留版式、图表位置和整体视觉呈现的同时，大幅减少了可恢复的文本。 已有工作支持这一方向，如图表数量与质量同引用量相关（Marshall et al., 2021），且论文的组织结构会影响同行评审结果（Jung et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: Having shown that paper content carries a recoverable, well-ranked decision signal, we now ask where that signal lives, across confidence ranges, papers, and conferences.
paragraphs.zh: 在已经证明论文内容包含可恢复且排序良好的决策信号之后，我们现在要探究该信号存在于何处——跨越不同置信度区间、论文和会议。

paragraphs.en: Confidence tracks accuracy. Like most modern neural networks ( Guo et al., 2017 ) , ours are mildly overconfident, with raw accept probabilities higher than their accuracy warrants, so we correct them with temperature scaling ( Guo et al., 2017 ) . We fit τ \tau on a natural-rate validation split with π \pi set to its acceptance rate, so the shift handles the base rate and τ \tau only sets sharpness. Jev’s scores already sit near the real acceptance rate, so we fit its τ \tau without the shift and apply the correction in reverse on our 50/50 test sets.

paragraphs.en: After scaling, both PaperScorer models track the y = x y{=}x line on both datasets (Figure 8 ), so their confidence matches their accuracy, and Jev, corrected the same way, is roughly calibrated too (ECE .05 .05 and .02 .02 , vs. .02 .02 – .03 .03 for ours). The difference is how often each model is confident (dashed coverage curves). At 70% confidence or more, PaperScorer covers about a third of ICLR papers and over half of arXiv papers, at nearly 80% and 85% accuracy, while Jev covers only 6% and 12%.

paragraphs.en: Deployment at the real acceptance rate. Most papers are rejected, and a venue’s rate π \pi can be estimated from previous years. Adding log ⁡ ( π / ( 1 − π ) ) \log(\pi/(1-\pi)) to ℓ \ell gives acceptance probabilities at that rate, cutting calibration error from .13 to .02–.03. At ICLR ’s rate, Accept calls are right 47% of the time and Reject calls 82% ( Appendix I.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在真实接收率下的部署。 大多数论文会被拒稿，而会议的接收率 \(\pi\) 可以根据往年的数据估计出来。 在 \(\ell\) 中加入 \(\log(\pi/(1-\pi))\) 可以使接收概率达到该接收率，将校准误差从 .13 降至 .02–.03。 按 ICLR 的接收率计算，Accept 判定有 47% 的时候是正确的，Reject 判定有 82% 是正确的（附录 I.3）。

paragraphs.en: Selective reliability. ICLR has human ground-truth ratings for each paper, so we can measure accuracy at each level of the human rating (Figure 9 a). Every model is most accurate at the lowest-rated papers and near chance in the middle of the rating range. The models differ at the top end, where PaperScorer -Vision stays accurate on the highest-rated papers while GPT and Gemini fall off, so the frontier models accurately predict the lowest-rated papers but fail on the highest-rated ones. Conditioning jointly on rating and confidence (Figure 9 b) shows the same shape, with accuracy peaking on the confident extremes and collapsing in the middle, where none of the evaluated models finds enough signal.
paragraphs.zh: 选择性可靠性。 ICLR 为每篇论文提供了人类真值评分，因此我们可以测量在人类评分各个层级上的准确率（图 9 a）。 每个模型在评分最低的论文上准确率最高，而在评分范围的中段则接近随机水平。 各模型在高分段表现不同：PaperScorer -Vision 在评分最高的论文上仍保持准确，而 GPT 和 Gemini 则出现下滑；因此，前沿模型能准确预测评分最低的论文，却在评分最高的论文上失败。 同时以评分和置信度为条件（图 9 b）呈现出相同的形态：准确率在置信度高的两端达到峰值，在中段则崩塌，而所有被评估的模型在那里都找不到足够的信号。

paragraphs.en: Performance across conferences. Accuracy varies sharply by venue (Figure 10 ). On six of the seven highest-coverage venues, PaperScorer -Vision matches or beats the best frontier model (Gemini-3.1-Pro or GPT-5.5). The exceptions are the vision-heavy CV venues, where the frontier models perform particularly well. Gemini ties PaperScorer on CVPR and is the most accurate model on ICCV, the only high-coverage venue where a frontier model wins. AAAI is the other extreme, with PaperScorer near 90 90 while both frontier models fall close to chance, the widest gap. AAAI accepts and rejects run equally long, so the gap is not a length effect; PaperScorer ranks them more cleanly here than anywhere else. In-domain training therefore gives PaperScorer a clear edge everywhere except the visual CV papers, where strong general vision models compete.
paragraphs.zh: 各会议的性能表现。 准确率因会议（venue）差异悬殊（图 10）。 在覆盖率最高的七个会议中的六个上，PaperScorer-Vision 追平或超越最佳前沿模型（Gemini-3.1-Pro 或 GPT-5.5）。 例外是以视觉为主的 CV 类会议，前沿模型在这些会议上表现尤为出色。 Gemini 在 CVPR 上与 PaperScorer 打平，并在 ICCV 上是最准确的模型，ICCV 是唯一一个前沿模型获胜的高覆盖率会议。 AAAI 则是另一个极端，PaperScorer 接近 90 90，而两个前沿模型都接近随机水平，差距最大。 AAAI 的录用和拒稿篇幅同样长，因此这一差距并非篇幅效应；PaperScorer 在这里对其排序的清晰度高于任何其他地方。 因此，领域内训练使 PaperScorer 在除视觉类 CV 论文之外的所有地方都拥有明显优势，而在视觉类 CV 论文上，强大的通用视觉模型可以与之竞争。

paragraphs.en: Paper acceptance prediction and dataset construction. Paper outcome prediction predates modern language models, with early work using bibliometric, lexical, and handcrafted signals ( Yan et al., 2011 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ; Hull and Bihlo, 2025 ) . Recent datasets and methods move closer to paper-level accept/reject prediction, including PeerRead ( Kang et al., 2018 ) , Deep Paper Gestalt ( Huang, 2018 ) , DeepReview ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) , ScholarPeer ( Goyal et al., 2026 ) , and Sakana’s AI Reviewer ( Lu et al., 2024 ) . The main challenge is label provenance, since prior sources mix arXiv, LaTeX, and OpenReview artifacts ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) , compare camera-ready accepts against anonymized rejects ( Lu et al., 2024 ) , or use workshop papers as reject proxies ( Huang, 2018 ) . These choices can make labels recoverable from source, venue, or revision artifacts (audited in Appendix B.1 ); we instead construct datasets in which the label is recoverable only from the paper’s content.
paragraphs.zh: 论文录用预测与数据集构建。 论文结果预测早于现代语言模型出现，早期工作使用文献计量、词汇和手工设计的信号（Yan 等，2011；Zhao 等，2025；Hull 和 Bihlo，2025）。 近期的数据集和方法更接近论文级别的录用/拒稿预测，包括 PeerRead（Kang 等，2018）、Deep Paper Gestalt（Huang，2018）、DeepReview（Zhu 等，2025）、ScholarPeer（Goyal 等，2026）以及 Sakana 的 AI 审稿人（Lu 等，2024）。 主要挑战在于标签来源，因为以往的数据源混合了 arXiv、LaTeX 和 OpenReview 的产物（Zhu 等，2025）、将终稿版录用稿与匿名化拒稿进行比较（Lu 等，2024），或将 workshop 论文作为拒稿的替代（Huang，2018）。 这些选择可能使标签可以从来源、会议或修订痕迹中恢复出来（审计见附录 B.1）；我们则构建仅能从论文内容恢复出标签的数据集。

paragraphs.en: Review generation and reviewer agents. A parallel line of work studies critique generation, review quality, reviewer agreement, and multi-agent review simulation rather than direct final-decision prediction. Reviewer2 ( Gao et al., 2024 ) analyzes reviewer behavior and agreement. DeepReview ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) , ReviewRL ( Zeng et al., 2025 ) , and OpenReviewer ( Idahl and Ahmadi, 2025 ) generate review-style outputs, while AgentReview ( Jin et al., 2024 ) , the Stanford Agentic Reviewer ( PaperReview.ai, 2025 ) , MARG ( D’Arcy et al., 2024 ) , MAMORX ( Taechoyotin et al., 2024 ) , and ScholarPeer ( Goyal et al., 2026 ) move toward agentic reviewing. These systems need reliable decision priors because generated critiques can be persuasive, yet when conditioned on the wrong prior they can lead to drastically different comments and decisions. We therefore ask whether a calibrated acceptance probability improves agentic reviewing ( Appendix K ).
paragraphs.zh: 综述生成与审稿人智能体。 另一条并行的研究路线关注的是评论生成、审稿质量、审稿人一致性以及多智能体审稿模拟，而非直接预测最终决定。 Reviewer2（Gao et al., 2024）分析了审稿人行为与一致性。 DeepReview（Zhu et al., 2025）、ReviewRL（Zeng et al., 2025）与 OpenReviewer（Idahl and Ahmadi, 2025）生成审稿风格的输出，而 AgentReview（Jin et al., 2024）、Stanford Agentic Reviewer（PaperReview.ai, 2025）、MARG（D'Arcy et al., 2024）、MAMORX（Taechoyotin et al., 2024）与 ScholarPeer（Goyal et al., 2026）则朝向智能体化审稿发展。 这些系统需要可靠的决策先验，因为生成的评论可能颇具说服力，而一旦基于错误的先验，它们可能导致截然不同的评论与决定。 因此，我们要问的是：校准后的接收概率能否改进智能体化审稿（附录 K）。

paragraphs.en: AI-assisted scientific workflows. Automated reviewing is also becoming part of larger scientific workflows. Systems such as The AI Scientist v1/v2 ( Lu et al., 2024 ; Yamada et al., 2025 ) , CycleResearcher ( Weng et al., 2025 ) , FunSearch ( Romera-Paredes et al., 2024 ) , AlphaEvolve ( Novikov et al., 2025 ) , and execution-grounded research agents ( Si et al., 2026 ) use model-based evaluation to filter ideas, judge generated artifacts, or steer search. AstaBench ( Bragg et al., 2026 ) formalizes evaluation for the full idea-to-paper setting. In these pipelines, reviewer models act as selection mechanisms rather than summarizers, so systematic accept bias or poor calibration can shape which research directions are pursued. This motivates PaperScorer as a calibrated decision prior for both retrieval and review assistance ( Appendix K ).
paragraphs.zh: AI 辅助的科学研究工作流。 自动化审稿也正在成为更大规模科学工作流的一部分。 诸如 The AI Scientist v1/v2（Lu et al., 2024；Yamada et al., 2025）、CycleResearcher（Weng et al., 2025）、FunSearch（Romera-Paredes et al., 2024）、AlphaEvolve（Novikov et al., 2025）以及基于执行的研究智能体（Si et al., 2026）等系统，使用基于模型的评估来筛选想法、评判生成的成果或引导搜索。 AstaBench（Bragg et al., 2026）为从想法到论文的完整场景形式化了评估方法。 在这些流程中，审稿模型充当的是选择机制而非总结者，因此系统性的接受偏差或糟糕的校准可能会影响哪些研究方向被 pursuing。 这促使我们将 PaperScorer 作为一种经过校准的决策先验，同时服务于检索和审稿辅助（附录 K）。

paragraphs.en: We introduce PaperScorer , a family of text and vision models that predict a paper’s final accept/reject decision from its content alone. Tested on ICLR and source-derived arXiv papers, supervised binary prediction recovers a strong paper-level signal, and 7B vision PaperScorer models outperform frontier reasoning and DeepReview baselines on decision accuracy and ranking, while producing calibrated acceptance probabilities. We find that paper artifacts contain substantial recoverable decision signal. Screenshots of the paper preserve layout, figure, and presentation cues that markdown extraction tends to discard.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 PaperScorer，这是一系列文本与视觉模型，能够仅凭论文内容预测其最终的录用/拒稿决定。 在 ICLR 论文和源自 arXiv 的论文上进行测试，有监督的二分类预测能够恢复较强的论文层面信号，并且 7B 视觉版 PaperScorer 模型在决策准确率和排名上优于前沿推理模型与 DeepReview 基线，同时还能给出经过校准的录用概率。 我们发现论文工件中包含大量可恢复的决策信号。 论文截图保留了版式、图表和呈现方面的线索，而这些往往是 markdown 提取容易丢弃的信息。

sents.en: We introduce PaperScorer , a family of text and vision models that predict a paper’s final accept/reject decision from its content alone.
sents.zh: 我们提出 PaperScorer，这是一系列文本与视觉模型，能够仅凭论文内容预测其最终的录用/拒稿决定。

sents.en: Tested on ICLR and source-derived arXiv papers, supervised binary prediction recovers a strong paper-level signal, and 7B vision PaperScorer models outperform frontier reasoning and DeepReview baselines on decision accuracy and ranking, while producing calibrated acceptance probabilities.
sents.zh: 在 ICLR 论文和源自 arXiv 的论文上进行测试，有监督的二分类预测能够恢复较强的论文层面信号，并且 7B 视觉版 PaperScorer 模型在决策准确率和排名上优于前沿推理模型与 DeepReview 基线，同时还能给出经过校准的录用概率。

sents.en: We find that paper artifacts contain substantial recoverable decision signal.
sents.zh: 我们发现论文工件中包含大量可恢复的决策信号。

sents.en: Screenshots of the paper preserve layout, figure, and presentation cues that markdown extraction tends to discard.
sents.zh: 论文截图保留了版式、图表和呈现方面的线索，而这些往往是 markdown 提取容易丢弃的信息。

paragraphs.en: PaperScorer is not a replacement for peer review or a universal measure of scientific value . Its best use is as a calibrated estimate of acceptance probability that larger scientific workflows can use as a prior, which we demonstrate in two settings ( Appendix K ). In literature retrieval, combining dense semantic retrieval scores from an embedding model with PaperScorer -Vision’s acceptance score surfaces papers that are both semantically relevant and likely to be accepted. On the LitSearch benchmark, this improves ground-truth citation recall in the top-10 results by 8.7% . In agentic reviewing, conditioning Claude Code on the PaperScorer -Vision prior raises decision accuracy from 63.0% to 70.6% and improves alignment with human reviews, mainly by correcting the agent’s incorrect acceptance predictions.
paragraphs.zh: PaperScorer 并非同行评审的替代品，也不是科学价值的通用衡量标准。 它的最佳用途是作为对录用概率的校准估计，供更大规模的科学工作流用作先验，我们在两种场景中展示了这一点（附录 K）。 在文献检索中，将嵌入模型的稠密语义检索得分与 PaperScorer -Vision 的录用得分相结合，能够同时筛选出语义相关且有可能被录用的论文。 在 LitSearch 基准上，这使前 10 个结果中真实引用的召回率提升了 8.7%。 在智能体审稿中，用 PaperScorer -Vision 先验对 Claude Code 进行条件约束，可将决策准确率从 63.0% 提升至 70.6%，并改善与人类审稿意见的一致性，主要通过纠正智能体错误的录用预测来实现。

paragraphs.en: We cannot yet say why the model favors one paper over another. Our attention maps and section-edit tests ( Appendix L.1 ) show what it reads, but they do not establish causality , and they rely on last-layer attention from only a few papers. The idea that vision performs better by capturing a paper’s overall look remains a conjecture, supported but not settled by our compression and modality results. The model also weakens on the newest papers, where our data is thin. By ’26, some decisions reflect AI help as much as human judgment, and dropping ’26 from training lowers accuracy ( Appendix F.2 ). That year is also unusual, with shorter rebuttals, the narrowest accept-reject rating gap we have seen, and arXiv labels from only a few venues. This should ease as more ’26 papers appear, and PaperScorer can be retrained through our pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还无法说明模型为何偏好某篇论文而非另一篇。 我们的注意力图和章节编辑测试（附录 L.1）显示了它阅读的内容，但这些并不能确立因果关系，且仅依赖于少数几篇论文的最后一层注意力。 视觉之所以表现更好是因为捕捉了论文的整体外观，这一想法仍属推测，我们的压缩和模态结果支持但并未确证它。 模型在最新论文上的表现也会减弱，因为我们在这些论文上的数据很少。 到 26 年，某些决策所反映的 AI 参与已不亚于人类判断，将 26 年从训练中剔除会降低准确率（附录 F.2）。 那一年也很特殊：反驳更短，录用与拒稿评分差距是我们所见最窄的，且 arXiv 标签只来自少数几个会议。 随着更多 26 年论文的出现，这种情况应当会缓解，并且可以通过我们的流程对 PaperScorer 进行再训练。

paragraphs.en: What the score captures. A high p accept p_{\mathrm{accept}} predicts the accept/reject outcome; it is not a measure of novelty or long-term impact, and it comes with no explanation of why (though it does have correlations to reviewer rating and citation count). On impact, the one slice with both full reviewer ratings and citations, ICLR ’25, is encouraging, as p accept p_{\mathrm{accept}} tracks later citations about as well as the human review score does ( ρ ≈ .25 \rho\approx.25 for both, Appendix J ), though one conference-year and small sample make this a preliminary result. The model itself provides no explanation for its prediction, so any reasoning for a decision must be generated afterward, by the model or an agentic reviewer. Conditioning a reviewer on p accept p_{\mathrm{accept}} raises agreement with human reviews ( Appendix K.2 ), but such post-hoc rationales can hallucinate. A more robust path likely needs multi-agent generation with verification loops.
paragraphs.zh: 该分数衡量的是什么。 较高的 p accept p_{\mathrm{accept}} 能预测接收/拒绝的结果；它并非衡量新颖性或长期影响力的指标，也不附带任何解释原因（尽管它与审稿人评分和引用次数存在相关性）。 在影响力方面，唯一同时拥有完整审稿人评分和引用数据的是 ICLR '25，结果令人鼓舞：p accept p_{\mathrm{accept}} 对后续引用的追踪效果与人类评审分数大致相当（两者 ρ ≈ .25 \rho\approx.25，见附录 J），不过仅有一个会议年份且样本量较小，这只是一个初步结果。 模型本身不会为其预测提供解释，因此任何决策的理由都必须事后生成，由模型或智能体审稿人完成。 用 p accept p_{\mathrm{accept}} 对审稿人进行条件约束可以提高与人类评审的一致性（见附录 K.2），但这类事后理由可能产生幻觉。 更稳健的路径可能需要带有验证循环的多智能体生成。

paragraphs.en: Future work. The clearest next steps are expanding high-fidelity datasets across more venues, improving borderline-paper modeling, and developing richer supervision than a single binary outcome, especially for cases where reviewer disagreement and venue-specific norms matter.
paragraphs.zh: 未来工作。 最明确的后续步骤包括：在更多会议与期刊上扩充高保真数据集、改进对边界论文的建模，并开发比单一二元结果更丰富的监督信号，尤其是在审稿人意见分歧和会议特有规范起重要作用的情形下。

paragraphs.en: This appendix provides supporting derivations, dataset documentation, extended evaluation, and training/inference details for the main paper:
paragraphs.zh: 本附录提供了正文的支持性推导、数据集文档、扩展评估以及训练/推理细节：

paragraphs.en: § A derives the Bayesian-optimal accuracy ceiling that anchors the 80.2% reference point in § 2 .
paragraphs.zh: § A 推导了贝叶斯最优准确率上限，该上限锚定了 § 2 中 80.2% 的参考点。

paragraphs.en: § B documents data provenance and the artifact-shortcut audit across our datasets and prior work.
paragraphs.zh: § B 记录了我们数据集及先前工作中数据来源与工件捷径审计的相关信息。

paragraphs.en: § C catalogs handcrafted feature probes and accept/reject distributions across ICLR and arXiv .
paragraphs.zh: § C 汇总了人工设计的特征探针以及 ICLR 与 arXiv 上的接收/拒绝分布。

paragraphs.en: § D tests whether frontier models can recall ground-truth decisions through label-recall and content-completion probes.
paragraphs.zh: § D 通过标签回忆与内容补全探针，检验前沿模型能否回忆起真实决策。

paragraphs.en: § E compares Qwen2.5 and Qwen3 text backbones on ICLR alongside their knowledge cutoffs.
paragraphs.zh: § E 在 ICLR 上比较了 Qwen2.5 和 Qwen3 文本骨干模型及其各自的知识截止时间。

paragraphs.en: § F reports data-mixture and input-representation ablations plus the reverse-order and prior diagnostics.
paragraphs.zh: § F 报告了数据混合与输入表示的消融实验，以及逆序和先验诊断。

paragraphs.en: § G reports cross-source transfer between ICLR and arXiv , including the arXiv-ICLR subset.
paragraphs.zh: § G 报告了 ICLR 与 arXiv 之间的跨源迁移，包括 arXiv-ICLR 子集。

paragraphs.en: § H records venue-specific prompts and prompt-correction studies for base open-source and frontier models.
paragraphs.zh: § H 记录了针对基础开源模型与前沿模型的特定场地提示词及提示词纠正研究。

paragraphs.en: § I covers SFT settings, the GRPO policy, and post-hoc temperature calibration.
paragraphs.zh: § I 涵盖 SFT 设置、GRPO 策略以及事后温度校准。

paragraphs.en: § J reports paired bootstrap intervals, rating/citation diagnostics, and a frontier repeatability audit.
paragraphs.zh: § J 报告了配对自助法区间、评分/引用诊断，以及前沿可重复性审计。

paragraphs.en: § K details the LitSearch reranking and agentic-reviewing applications of the calibrated PaperScorer prior, including the Claude Code reviewer scaffolding and Codex grading rubric.
paragraphs.zh: § K 详细介绍了经过校准的 PaperScorer 先验在 LitSearch 重排序和智能体审查应用中的使用，包括 Claude Code 审查者框架与 Codex 评分标准。

paragraphs.en: § L analyzes section-level attention maps and the four-commit Codex edit experiments.
paragraphs.zh: § L 分析了章节级注意力图以及四次提交的 Codex 编辑实验。

paragraphs.en: We follow the NeurIPS ’14 / ’21 consistency experiment ( Beygelzimer et al., 2021 ) , where each paper i i is reviewed by two committees j ∈ { 1 , 2 } j\in\{1,2\} with independent decisions conditional on a latent acceptance probability p i ∼ F p_{i}\sim F (step a ). Here F F is the (unknown) population distribution of per-paper acceptance probabilities, whose first two moments we estimate from the consistency experiment below. The experiment’s reported acceptance rate of ≈ 26 % {\approx}\,26\% fixes the first moment (step b ), and its disagreement rate of ≈ 23 % {\approx}\,23\% corresponds to 𝔼 ⁡ [ 2 ​ p ​ ( 1 − p ) ] \mathbb{E}[2p(1-p)] (step c ), which expands into the second moment and variance (steps d , e ). Matching these to a Beta family (steps f , g ) gives ( α , β ) ≈ ( 0.39 , 1.10 ) (\alpha,\beta)\approx(0.39,1.10) . Under the natural acceptance distribution, the Bayes-optimal predictor accepts when p > 0.5 p>0.5 , giving Acc ⋆ ≈ 83.3 % \mathrm{Acc}^{\star}\approx 83.3\% (step h ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们遵循 NeurIPS ’14 / ’21 一致性实验（Beygelzimer et al., 2021），其中每篇论文 i i 由两个委员会 j ∈ { 1 , 2 } j\in\{1,2\} 进行评审，在潜在接受概率 p i ∼ F p_{i}\sim F 的条件下各委员会独立作出决定（步骤 a）。 这里 F F 是每篇论文接受概率的（未知的）总体分布，我们在下文的一致性实验中估计其前两阶矩。 该实验报告的约 26 % {\approx}\,26\% 的接受率确定了第一阶矩（步骤 b），其约 23 % {\approx}\,23\% 的分歧率对应于 𝔼 ⁡ [ 2 ​ p ​ ( 1 − p ) ] \mathbb{E}[2p(1-p)]（步骤 c），后者可展开得到第二阶矩和方差（步骤 d、e）。 将其与 Beta 分布族相匹配（步骤 f、g）得到 ( α , β ) ≈ ( 0.39 , 1.10 ) (\alpha,\beta)\approx(0.39,1.10)。 在这一自然的接受概率分布下，贝叶斯最优预测器在 p > 0.5 p>0.5 时接受，得到 Acc ⋆ ≈ 83.3 % \mathrm{Acc}^{\star}\approx 83.3\%（步骤 h）。

paragraphs.en: Our evaluation uses a balanced 50/50 pool of accepted and rejected papers, so the relevant ceiling differs. Beta-Bernoulli conjugacy gives the conditional posteriors in step i , and under a uniform 50/50 class prior the posterior accept probability (step j ) equals 0.5 0.5 exactly at p = α / ( α + β ) = 0.26 p=\alpha/(\alpha+\beta)=0.26 . The Bayes-optimal rule in the balanced setting therefore predicts accept when p > 0.26 p>0.26 . Averaging over the two conditional Beta distributions yields the balanced ceiling in step k , the value reported in the main text.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的评估使用了录用与拒稿论文各占50%的均衡池，因此相关的上限有所不同。 Beta-Bernoulli 共轭给出了步骤 i 中的条件后验分布，且在均匀的50/50类别先验下，后验收录概率（步骤 j）恰好在 p = α / ( α + β ) = 0.26 p=\alpha/(\alpha+\beta)=0.26 处等于 0.5 0.5。 因此，在均衡设置下，贝叶斯最优规则在 p > 0.26 p>0.26 时预测录用。 对两个条件 Beta 分布取平均即得到步骤 k 中的均衡上限，也就是正文中所报告的数值。

sents.en: Our evaluation uses a balanced 50/50 pool of accepted and rejected papers, so the relevant ceiling differs.
sents.zh: 我们的评估使用了录用与拒稿论文各占50%的均衡池，因此相关的上限有所不同。

sents.en: Beta-Bernoulli conjugacy gives the conditional posteriors in step i , and under a uniform 50/50 class prior the posterior accept probability (step j ) equals 0.5 0.5 exactly at p = α / ( α + β ) = 0.26 p=\alpha/(\alpha+\beta)=0.26 .
sents.zh: Beta-Bernoulli 共轭给出了步骤 i 中的条件后验分布，且在均匀的50/50类别先验下，后验收录概率（步骤 j）恰好在 p = α / ( α + β ) = 0.26 p=\alpha/(\alpha+\beta)=0.26 处等于 0.5 0.5。

sents.en: The Bayes-optimal rule in the balanced setting therefore predicts accept when p > 0.26 p>0.26 .
sents.zh: 因此，在均衡设置下，贝叶斯最优规则在 p > 0.26 p>0.26 时预测录用。

sents.en: Averaging over the two conditional Beta distributions yields the balanced ceiling in step k , the value reported in the main text.
sents.zh: 对两个条件 Beta 分布取平均即得到步骤 k 中的均衡上限，也就是正文中所报告的数值。

paragraphs.en: Existing accept/reject datasets often mix artifacts in ways that make labels recoverable from source, venue, or revision artifacts rather than from the paper’s content. For instance, Deep Paper Gestalt ( Huang, 2018 ) pairs accepted CVPR papers against workshop papers as a reject pool, but the workshop format alone (shorter page count, distinct headers) is enough to shortcut the prediction problem without ever reading the paper. We compare three public datasets, DeepReview ’24–’25 ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) , Sakana’s AI Scientist ’22 ( Lu et al., 2024 ) , and our raw ICLR ’24 (before normalization), against the selected PaperScorer years. We tested several signals defined in Table B.1 , and Table B.2 reports accept/reject percentages (A/R) for each.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的接收/拒绝数据集往往以各种方式混杂了人工痕迹，使得标签可以从来源、会议或修订痕迹中恢复出来，而不是从论文内容本身恢复。 例如，Deep Paper Gestalt（Huang, 2018）将已被接收的 CVPR 论文与研讨会论文作为拒绝池进行配对，但仅凭研讨会论文的格式（更短的页数、不同的页眉）就足以在不阅读论文的情况下走捷径完成预测任务。 我们将三个公开数据集——DeepReview ’24–’25（Zhu et al., 2025）、Sakana 的 AI Scientist ’22（Lu et al., 2024）以及我们的原始 ICLR ’24（归一化之前）——与 PaperScorer 所选年份进行了比较。 我们测试了表 B.1 中定义的多个信号，表 B.2 报告了每个信号的接收/拒绝百分比（A/R）。

paragraphs.en: Among the comparators, DeepReview ’24 carries source for 78.7% of accepts but only 41.2% of rejects, a strong leakage shortcut. AI Scientist ’22 has 100% of accept papers with visible author names against essentially zero reject papers, because the rejects come from anonymized OpenReview submissions while the accepts are camera-ready PDFs. Our selected years stay at most 0.92% A / 1.73% R on any signal. Our audit shows that sourcing papers from the latest pre-camera-ready rebuttal artifact does not suffer from any of these shortcuts.
paragraphs.zh: 在各对比数据集中，DeepReview '24 中 78.7% 的录用论文带有来源信息，而被拒论文中仅有 41.2% 带有来源信息，这是一个很强的泄漏捷径。 AI Scientist '22 中 100% 的录用论文都能看到作者姓名，而被拒论文几乎为零，这是因为被拒论文来自匿名的 OpenReview 提交版本，而录用论文则是定稿 PDF。 我们选定的年份在任何信号上的泄漏比例最高不超过 0.92%（录用）/ 1.73%（拒稿）。 我们的审计表明，从最新的 camera-ready 之前 rebuttal 阶段工件中获取论文来源，不会受到上述任何捷径的影响。

paragraphs.en: Artifact availability across OpenReview venues. We audit which submission, rebuttal, camera-ready, and reject artifacts are public across the OpenReview venues and years we considered, and use the result to decide which year/version of each paper to keep. Yellow cells in Table B.3 mark the coverage used in ICLR : for ICLR we keep ’20–’23 (initial-submission and rebuttal artifacts) and ’25–’26 (latest-rebuttal PDFs that are public without the camera-ready transition), and we exclude ’24 entirely. NeurIPS, ICML, and COLM publish only accepts on OpenReview, so we only source ICLR submissions from OpenReview.
paragraphs.zh: OpenReview 各会议中工件（artifact）的可用性。 我们审计了所考虑的 OpenReview 各会议与年份中，哪些投稿、反驳、定稿以及被拒论文的工件是公开的，并利用该结果来决定每篇论文保留哪个年份/版本。 表 B.3 中的黄色单元格标注了 ICLR 所采用的覆盖范围：对于 ICLR，我们保留 ’20–’23（初始投稿与反驳阶段的工件）以及 ’25–’26（无需经过定稿转换即可公开的最新反驳 PDF），并完全排除 ’24。 NeurIPS、ICML 和 COLM 在 OpenReview 上仅公布被接收的论文，因此我们只从 OpenReview 获取 ICLR 的投稿。

paragraphs.en: Why we exclude ICLR ’24. For ’24, neither the initial submission nor the latest rebuttal PDF is publicly available, so the only artifact we can recover is the camera-ready version of accepts paired with the latest rebuttal of rejects. We attempted to recover an anonymized version of ICLR ’24 by performing manual anonymization on the camera-ready PDF. We strip identity-bearing spans from text and whiten the same regions in rendered pages, but the camera-ready transition still shifts page layout and section start positions ( Figure B.1 ). Vision picks this up. Even after normalization, the model remains unusually strong on ’24, indicating that residual layout cues survive whiteout. MinerU confirms the source of the problem. Across years, the mean y y -position of the introduction start is roughly matched between accepts and rejects, except in ’24 where the gap is notable. This is consistent with author-block expansion, GitHub insertion, and whitespace changes after masking, which is why ’24 is excluded from the benchmark and training pool.
paragraphs.zh: 为什么我们排除 ICLR ’24。 对于 ’24，无论是初投稿还是最新 rebuttal 的 PDF 都未公开，因此我们唯一能获取的产物是被录用的 camera-ready 版本与被拒稿的最新 rebuttal 的配对。 我们尝试通过对 camera-ready PDF 进行手动匿名化来恢复 ICLR ’24 的匿名版本。 我们从文本中去除含身份信息的片段，并在渲染页面中将相同区域涂白，但 camera-ready 阶段的转换仍会改变页面布局和章节起始位置（图 B.1）。视觉模型能捕捉到这一点。 即使经过归一化，模型在 ’24 上仍然异常强大，这表明残留的布局线索在涂白后依然存在。 MinerU 证实了问题的来源。 跨年度来看，引言起始位置的平均 y y 坐标在接受稿与拒绝稿之间大致匹配，唯独在 ’24 差距明显。 这与遮盖后作者信息块扩展、GitHub 链接插入以及空白变化相一致，这也是 ’24 被排除在基准和训练池之外的原因。

paragraphs.en: ICLR submission metadata across years. Beyond artifact availability, the venues themselves change over time. Table B.4 compares page limits, rating scales, and artifact availability across ICLR ’20–’26. The rating scale shifts repeatedly — 4-point in ’20, 10-point in ’21, then 6-point from ’22 onward — so we normalize all reviewer ratings into percentile space before computing any rating-aligned metric. Page limits also creep up across the rebuttal and camera-ready windows; we account for this with explicit length filters per year.
paragraphs.zh: 跨年度的 ICLR 投稿元数据。 除了产出物可得性之外，会议本身也会随时间变化。 表 B.4 比较了 ICLR '20–'26 各年的页数限制、评分量表与产出物可得性。 评分量表多次变动——'20 年为 4 分制，'21 年为 10 分制，'22 年起为 6 分制——因此我们在计算任何与评分相关的指标之前，先将所有审稿人评分归一化到百分位空间。 在 rebuttal 与 camera-ready 阶段，页数限制也逐年放宽；我们通过按年份设置明确的长度过滤器来处理这一点。

paragraphs.en: We run two independent workflows that produce two independent datasets. The ICLR workflow downloads ICLR submissions and decisions directly from OpenReview, runs MinerU, redacts identity, and subsamples. The arXiv workflow recovers both the venue and the decision from each paper’s arXiv source tarball and matches against public paperlists. Figures 2(a) and 2(b) show the two funnels, and Table B.5 summarizes the final canonical training pools used throughout the paper.
paragraphs.zh: 我们运行了两条相互独立的工作流，产出两个相互独立的数据集。 ICLR 工作流直接从 OpenReview 下载 ICLR 投稿与录用决定，运行 MinerU，抹除身份信息，并进行子采样。 arXiv 工作流从每篇论文的 arXiv 源码压缩包中恢复会议（venue）与录用决定，并与公开的论文列表进行匹配。 图 2(a) 和图 2(b) 展示了这两条漏斗，表 B.5 汇总了全文所使用的最终规范化训练池。

sents.en: We run two independent workflows that produce two independent datasets.
sents.zh: 我们运行了两条相互独立的工作流，产出两个相互独立的数据集。

paragraphs.en: We pull every ICLR submission in OpenReview for ’20–’26 (45,328 papers) and, per year, the latest publicly available pre-camera-ready PDF. PDFs run through MinerU to obtain markdown and per-page images, then we redact identity-bearing spans (author block, affiliations, acknowledgments, GitHub links). After joining with reviews and decisions and applying an 85/5/10 stratified split balanced per (year, decision) cell, we obtain 24,888 papers (’20: 1,367; ’21: 1,610; ’22: 2,154; ’23: 3,088; ’25: 6,790; ’26: 9,879).
paragraphs.zh: 我们拉取了 OpenReview 上 ’20–’26 年份的所有 ICLR 投稿（共 45,328 篇论文），并按年份获取相机就绪前最新公开的 PDF。 PDF 通过 MinerU 处理得到 markdown 和逐页图像，然后我们抹除包含身份信息的片段（作者栏、所属机构、致谢、GitHub 链接）。 在与评审和录用决定关联，并按 (年份, 录用决定) 单元格分层进行 85/5/10 划分后，我们得到 24,888 篇论文（’20：1,367；’21：1,610；’22：2,154；’23：3,088；’25：6,790；’26：9,879）。

sents.en: We pull every ICLR submission in OpenReview for ’20–’26 (45,328 papers) and, per year, the latest publicly available pre-camera-ready PDF.
sents.zh: 我们拉取了 OpenReview 上 ’20–’26 年份的所有 ICLR 投稿（共 45,328 篇论文），并按年份获取相机就绪前最新公开的 PDF。

sents.en: PDFs run through MinerU to obtain markdown and per-page images, then we redact identity-bearing spans (author block, affiliations, acknowledgments, GitHub links).
sents.zh: PDF 通过 MinerU 处理得到 markdown 和逐页图像，然后我们抹除包含身份信息的片段（作者栏、所属机构、致谢、GitHub 链接）。

sents.en: After joining with reviews and decisions and applying an 85/5/10 stratified split balanced per (year, decision) cell, we obtain 24,888 papers (’20: 1,367; ’21: 1,610; ’22: 2,154; ’23: 3,088; ’25: 6,790; ’26: 9,879).

paragraphs.en: We start from 434,579 ML arXiv papers spanning ’20–’26 by update date. We pull source directly from arXiv’s requester-pays S3 mirror ( s3://arxiv/src/ ) for every paper from January ’20 through our 05/01/’26 cutoff, and use NeMo Curator’s vendored ArxivIterator ( NVIDIA, 2024 ) to walk each monthly tar and recover the per-paper .tex contents. We then scan every .tex against our tracked-venue templates and keep only the tarballs that match a known venue style file. The workflow detects the submission venue from the LaTeX source via these venue-specific style files, strips identity-bearing spans directly from the LaTeX source (author block, affiliations, acknowledgments, GitHub links) and recompiles the PDF, runs MinerU, and matches each in-pool paper against every venue paperlist in the public Paper Copilot index ( Yang et al., 2026 ) within a Y − 5 Y{-}5 to Y + 2 Y{+}2 year window. Papers that template for a venue with ground-truth but find no paperlist match are tagged as implied rejects and kept, unless they trigger a workshop, short-paper, or no-ground-truth filter that drops them. Per-venue 50:50 balancing with a stratified 85/5/10 split yields the arXiv dataset of 83,656 papers spanning NeurIPS, CVPR, ACL, AAAI, ICLR, ICML, and other ML venues. Throughout the paper we use the full arXiv set. For compute-matched ablations, we use the subsample arXiv-m , produced by proportional per-(venue, label) downsampling of arXiv to 24,650 papers.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从按更新日期覆盖 2020 至 2026 年的 434,579 篇 ML arXiv 论文出发。 对于 2020 年 1 月至 2026 年 5 月 1 日截止日期的每一篇论文，我们直接从 arXiv 的 requester-pays S3 镜像（ s3://arxiv/src/ ）拉取源码，并使用 NeMo Curator 内置的 ArxivIterator（ NVIDIA, 2024 ）遍历每个月度 tar 包并恢复每篇论文的 .tex 内容。 然后，我们用所追踪会议的模板扫描每一个 .tex 文件，仅保留匹配已知会议样式文件的 tar 包。 该工作流通过这些特定于会议的样式文件从 LaTeX 源码中检测投稿会议，直接从 LaTeX 源码中剥离包含身份信息的片段（作者信息块、机构、致谢、GitHub 链接）并重新编译 PDF，运行 MinerU，并在 Y − 5 Y{-}5 到 Y + 2 Y{+}2 年的时间窗口内，将池中的每一篇论文与公开的 Paper Copilot 索引（ Yang et al., 2026 ）中的每一个会议论文列表进行匹配。 那些套用了某个有真实标签会议模板但未找到论文列表匹配的论文被标记为隐式拒绝（implied rejects）并予以保留，除非它们触发了 workshop、短文或无真实标签的过滤规则而被剔除。 按会议进行 50:50 平衡，并采用 85/5/10 的分层划分，最终得到了涵盖 NeurIPS、CVPR、ACL、AAAI、ICLR、ICML 及其他 ML 会议、共 83,656 篇论文的 arXiv 数据集。 在全文中我们使用完整的 arXiv 集合。 对于计算量匹配的消融实验，我们使用子集 arXiv-m ，它是通过对 arXiv 按每个（会议，标签）成比例下采样到 24,650 篇论文而得到的。

sents.en: We pull source directly from arXiv’s requester-pays S3 mirror ( s3://arxiv/src/ ) for every paper from January ’20 through our 05/01/’26 cutoff, and use NeMo Curator’s vendored ArxivIterator ( NVIDIA, 2024 ) to walk each monthly tar and recover the per-paper .tex contents.

sents.en: We then scan every .tex against our tracked-venue templates and keep only the tarballs that match a known venue style file.

sents.en: The workflow detects the submission venue from the LaTeX source via these venue-specific style files, strips identity-bearing spans directly from the LaTeX source (author block, affiliations, acknowledgments, GitHub links) and recompiles the PDF, runs MinerU, and matches each in-pool paper against every venue paperlist in the public Paper Copilot index ( Yang et al., 2026 ) within a Y − 5 Y{-}5 to Y + 2 Y{+}2 year window.

paragraphs.en: GPT-5.5’s December ’25 knowledge cutoff postdates the public release of ICLR ’25 decisions and most of our arXiv test years, so a natural worry is that its baseline accuracy comes from remembering outcomes rather than judging papers. Gemini-3.1-Pro (January ’25 cutoff) predates both. We test this in two steps. First, we ask whether the models remember our test papers at all. Second, and more importantly, we ask whether remembering a paper makes the model any more accurate on it.
paragraphs.zh: GPT-5.5 的知识截止日期为 2025 年 12 月，晚于 ICLR '25 决策的公开发布以及我们大多数 arXiv 测试年份，因此一个自然的担忧是，其基线准确率来自对结果的记忆而非对论文的评判。 Gemini-3.1-Pro（知识截止日期为 2025 年 1 月）则早于上述两者。 我们分两步对此进行检验。 第一步，我们考察这些模型是否记得我们的测试论文。 第二步，也是更重要的一步，我们考察记住某篇论文是否会让模型在该论文上更加准确。

sents.zh: Gemini-3.1-Pro（知识截止日期为 2025 年 1 月）则早于上述两者。

sents.zh: 我们分两步对此进行检验。

sents.en: First, we ask whether the models remember our test papers at all.
sents.zh: 第一步，我们考察这些模型是否记得我们的测试论文。

paragraphs.en: We sample 200 papers per corpus (100 accepted, 100 rejected) from the papers on which GPT-5.5 is evaluated in Table 3 , so that every probed paper also has a prediction from the main table. Each paper is probed with five label-recall cues that ask the model whether it remembers the paper’s decision:
paragraphs.zh: 我们从表3中评估GPT-5.5的论文中，每个语料库抽取200篇论文（100篇录用、100篇拒稿），以确保每篇被探测的论文在主表中也有对应的预测结果。 每篇论文通过五条标签回忆提示进行探测，询问模型是否记得该论文的评审决定：

sents.en: We sample 200 papers per corpus (100 accepted, 100 rejected) from the papers on which GPT-5.5 is evaluated in Table 3 , so that every probed paper also has a prediction from the main table.
sents.zh: 我们从表3中评估GPT-5.5的论文中，每个语料库抽取200篇论文（100篇录用、100篇拒稿），以确保每篇被探测的论文在主表中也有对应的预测结果。

sents.en: Each paper is probed with five label-recall cues that ask the model whether it remembers the paper’s decision:
sents.zh: 每篇论文通过五条标签回忆提示进行探测，询问模型是否记得该论文的评审决定：

paragraphs.en: mc — multiple choice among accept, reject, and a distractor, given the title and abstract.
paragraphs.zh: mc — 给定标题和摘要，在接受、拒绝和一个干扰项之间进行多项选择。

paragraphs.en: continuation — the first sentence after the abstract, asking whether the model recognizes the paper.
paragraphs.zh: 续写 —— 摘要之后的第一句话，询问模型是否认得这篇论文。

paragraphs.en: web_search_framing — a prompt phrased as if the model could look up the venue and outcome.
paragraphs.zh: web_search_framing — 提示词的措辞仿佛模型可以查询场地和结果。

paragraphs.en: For each cue we report the claim rate , the fraction of papers where the model says it remembers the decision, and the outcome accuracy when claimed . A sixth content-recall cue asks the model to continue the abstract from its title, scored by ROUGE-L ( Lin, 2004 ) . Gemini-3.1-Pro was probed on an earlier 50-paper draw per corpus with the same cues.
paragraphs.zh: 对每个线索，我们报告声称率，即模型声称记得该决策的论文比例，以及声称时的结果准确率。 第六个内容回忆线索要求模型根据标题续写摘要，用 ROUGE-L（Lin, 2004）评分。 Gemini-3.1-Pro 在每个语料库较早抽取的 50 篇论文上用相同的线索进行了探测。

paragraphs.en: Table D.1 shows that GPT-5.5 does recognize many of our test papers, and that recognition follows its cutoff exactly. On ICLR , the title cue is claimed for 30% of ’25 papers but only 7% of ’26 papers, and on arXiv for 44% of ’24 papers but 17% of ’25 and 23% of ’26. Gemini-3.1-Pro claims recall for at most 4% of ICLR papers under any cue. Recognition is not the same as remembering the decision, however. When GPT-5.5 claims to recall a decision it is right only 50–73% of the time, and this is inflated by an accept bias: it says “accept” for 65% of the ICLR papers it claims to remember, so balanced accuracy over its claimed decisions is 44%, no better than chance. Content recall is absent: mean ROUGE-L on abstract continuation is ≤ 0.004 \leq 0.004 on every slice and no paper reaches 0.5 0.5 .
paragraphs.zh: 表 D.1 显示，GPT-5.5 确实能识别出我们的许多测试论文，且这种识别与其截止日期完全吻合。 在 ICLR 上，「论文标题」线索对 ’25 年论文的声称率为 30%，而对 ’26 年论文仅为 7%；在 arXiv 上，对 ’24 年论文的声称率为 44%，对 ’25 年论文为 17%，对 ’26 年论文为 23%。 在任何线索条件下，Gemini-3.1-Pro 对 ICLR 论文的召回声称率最高只有 4%。 然而，识别并不等同于记得评审决定。 当 GPT-5.5 声称记得某个评审决定时，它只有 50–73% 的时候是对的，而且这一数字被「接收偏好」所夸大：在它声称记得的 ICLR 论文中，它对 65% 的论文说「接收」，因此其声称决定上的平衡准确率为 44%，并不比随机猜测好。 内容召回则完全缺失：在摘要续写任务上，所有切片的平均 ROUGE-L 均 ≤ 0.004，且没有一篇论文达到 0.5。

sents.en: Table D.1 shows that GPT-5.5 does recognize many of our test papers, and that recognition follows its cutoff exactly.
sents.zh: 表 D.1 显示，GPT-5.5 确实能识别出我们的许多测试论文，且这种识别与其截止日期完全吻合。

sents.zh: 在任何线索条件下，Gemini-3.1-Pro 对 ICLR 论文的召回声称率最高只有 4%。

sents.zh: 然而，识别并不等同于记得评审决定。
