paragraphs.en: If GPT-5.5 were retrieving remembered decisions, it would be more accurate on the papers it recognizes. We split each probed corpus into papers it claimed to recall under at least one cue and papers it never claimed, and compare its accuracy from Table 3 on the two groups ( Table D.2 ). Recognized papers are no easier on either dataset (permutation p = .28 p=.28 and .88 .88 ), including on ICLR ’25, the only ICLR year inside its cutoff, and accuracy does not rise with the number of cues under which a paper is recognized. Papers whose recalled decision happened to be correct do score higher, but this is circular, since those are the papers where the model’s impression already matched the outcome.
paragraphs.zh: 如果 GPT-5.5 真的在检索记忆中的决策，那么它在能识别出的论文上应该更准确。 我们将被探测的每个语料库拆分为它声称在至少一个提示下能回忆起的论文和它从未声称回忆过的论文，并比较其在表 3 中对两组论文的准确率（表 D.2）。 在两个数据集上，被识别出的论文并不更容易（置换检验 p = .28 和 .88），包括 ICLR ’25——唯一一个在其截止日期内的 ICLR 年份——而且准确率并不会随论文被识别出的提示数量增加而上升。 回忆出的决策恰好正确的论文确实得分更高，但这是循环论证，因为这些正是模型的印象已经与结果相符的论文。

sents.en: If GPT-5.5 were retrieving remembered decisions, it would be more accurate on the papers it recognizes.
sents.zh: 如果 GPT-5.5 真的在检索记忆中的决策，那么它在能识别出的论文上应该更准确。

sents.en: We split each probed corpus into papers it claimed to recall under at least one cue and papers it never claimed, and compare its accuracy from Table 3 on the two groups ( Table D.2 ).
sents.zh: 我们将被探测的每个语料库拆分为它声称在至少一个提示下能回忆起的论文和它从未声称回忆过的论文，并比较其在表 3 中对两组论文的准确率（表 D.2）。

sents.en: Recognized papers are no easier on either dataset (permutation p = .28 p=.28 and .88 .88 ), including on ICLR ’25, the only ICLR year inside its cutoff, and accuracy does not rise with the number of cues under which a paper is recognized.
sents.zh: 在两个数据集上，被识别出的论文并不更容易（置换检验 p = .28 和 .88），包括 ICLR ’25——唯一一个在其截止日期内的 ICLR 年份——而且准确率并不会随论文被识别出的提示数量增加而上升。

sents.en: Papers whose recalled decision happened to be correct do score higher, but this is circular, since those are the papers where the model’s impression already matched the outcome.
sents.zh: 回忆出的决策恰好正确的论文确实得分更高，但这是循环论证，因为这些正是模型的印象已经与结果相符的论文。

paragraphs.en: We conclude that GPT-5.5 recognizes a substantial fraction of our test papers but does not retrieve their decisions, and that its baseline accuracy in Table 3 is not explained by memorization.
paragraphs.zh: 我们得出结论：GPT-5.5 能识别出我们相当一部分测试论文，但无法检索到它们的判定结果，且其在表 3 中的基线准确率并非由记忆效应所解释。

paragraphs.en: To check whether our backbone choice drives the results, we retrain the text model on ICLR with a Qwen3-8B backbone ( Yang et al., 2025 ) using the same SFT recipe as PaperScorer -Text, and compare against the Qwen2.5-7B backbone used throughout the paper. Table E.1 reports overall ICLR accuracy and per-class recall together with each model’s knowledge cutoff. The newer Qwen3 generation includes public ICLR ’25 outcomes (text released April 28, ’25; VL on September 22, ’25) but not ICLR ’26, whereas Qwen2.5 predates both.

paragraphs.en: The main text reports balanced test metrics because our decision objective is Acc. This is compatible with natural-rate reporting when balanced and natural samples come from the same curated domain distribution. The accept and reject recalls estimated on a balanced test can be reweighted by the natural accept prior. Table F.1 checks this directly for matched ICLR and arXiv 7B text and vision predictors. Across all four cells, the empirical natural-rate accuracy lands within a few percentage points of the prior-extrapolated value, so the balanced test keeps the metric aligned with the objective.
paragraphs.zh: 正文报告的是均衡测试指标，因为我们的决策目标是 Acc。 当均衡样本与自然样本来自同一个经过整理的领域分布时，这与按自然比率报告是相容的。 在均衡测试上估计的接受与拒绝召回率，可以通过自然的接受先验进行重新加权。 表 F.1 针对匹配的 ICLR 和 arXiv 7B 文本与视觉预测器直接验证了这一点。 在全部四个单元格中，经验自然比率准确率与先验外推值相差仅几个百分点以内，因此均衡测试使指标与目标保持一致。

paragraphs.en: We explored two families of training ablations on ICLR to improve decision accuracy. The first filtered training papers to high-quality accepts and rejects by reviewer rating, dropping borderline papers. The second tested additional context suffixes such as paper statistics, agent-generated reviews, and vision-text fusion to support the decision objective. Both are summarized in Table F.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 ICLR 上探索了两组训练消融实验，以提高决策准确率。 第一组将训练论文筛选为评审评分较高的录用和拒稿论文，剔除了边缘论文。 第二组测试了额外的上下文后缀，例如论文统计信息、智能体生成的评审意见以及视觉-文本融合，以支持决策目标。 两者总结于表 F.2 中。

sents.en: We explored two families of training ablations on ICLR to improve decision accuracy.
sents.zh: 我们在 ICLR 上探索了两组训练消融实验，以提高决策准确率。

sents.en: The first filtered training papers to high-quality accepts and rejects by reviewer rating, dropping borderline papers.
sents.zh: 第一组将训练论文筛选为评审评分较高的录用和拒稿论文，剔除了边缘论文。

sents.en: The second tested additional context suffixes such as paper statistics, agent-generated reviews, and vision-text fusion to support the decision objective.
sents.zh: 第二组测试了额外的上下文后缀，例如论文统计信息、智能体生成的评审意见以及视觉-文本融合，以支持决策目标。

sents.en: Both are summarized in Table F.2 .
sents.zh: 两者总结于表 F.2 中。

paragraphs.en: Table F.2 a shows that training only on pre-’26 data does not transfer well to ’26. To improve the quality of the corpus, we tried to filter out borderline cases via Rating-Agreeing , which keeps only accepts in [ 0.6 , 1 ] [0.6,1] and rejects in [ 0 , 0.4 ] [0,0.4] by percentile rating. It helps on ’25, but once ’26 is included, it does not improve either modality noticeably. Table F.2 b explains why: ’26 is fundamentally a different distribution , since the rebuttal process was cut short, author-reviewer discussion was not allowed, and reviewers could not raise scores, yielding the smallest accept-reject gap. Table F.2 c shows that additional context helps text, especially for ’26 transfer, but harms vision, our strongest model. We therefore train on the simplest paper-only pool, ’20–’23, ’25–’26 ∗ , which gives the strongest vision results without sacrificing text performance.
paragraphs.zh: 表 F.2 a 表明，仅在 ’26 之前的数据上训练并不能很好地迁移到 ’26。 为了提高语料库的质量，我们尝试通过 Rating-Agreeing 过滤掉边界情况，该方法按百分位评分仅保留 [0.6, 1] 区间的录用样本和 [0, 0.4] 区间的拒稿样本。 这在 ’25 上有所帮助，但一旦纳入 ’26，无论哪种模态都没有明显提升。 表 F.2 b 解释了原因：’26 在根本上是一个不同的分布，因为 rebuttal 流程被缩短，不允许作者与审稿人讨论，审稿人也不能提高分数，从而产生了最小的录用-拒稿差距。 表 F.2 c 表明，额外的上下文对文本有帮助，尤其是对 ’26 的迁移，但会损害视觉性能，即我们最强的模型。 因此，我们在最简单的仅论文数据池 ’20–’23、’25–’26 ∗ 上进行训练，这在不牺牲文本性能的情况下获得了最强的视觉结果。

sents.en: Table F.2 a shows that training only on pre-’26 data does not transfer well to ’26.
sents.zh: 表 F.2 a 表明，仅在 ’26 之前的数据上训练并不能很好地迁移到 ’26。

sents.zh: 这在 ’25 上有所帮助，但一旦纳入 ’26，无论哪种模态都没有明显提升。

sents.en: Table F.2 b explains why: ’26 is fundamentally a different distribution , since the rebuttal process was cut short, author-reviewer discussion was not allowed, and reviewers could not raise scores, yielding the smallest accept-reject gap.
sents.zh: 表 F.2 b 解释了原因：’26 在根本上是一个不同的分布，因为 rebuttal 流程被缩短，不允许作者与审稿人讨论，审稿人也不能提高分数，从而产生了最小的录用-拒稿差距。

sents.en: Table F.2 c shows that additional context helps text, especially for ’26 transfer, but harms vision, our strongest model.
sents.zh: 表 F.2 c 表明，额外的上下文对文本有帮助，尤其是对 ’26 的迁移，但会损害视觉性能，即我们最强的模型。

sents.en: We therefore train on the simplest paper-only pool, ’20–’23, ’25–’26 ∗ , which gives the strongest vision results without sacrificing text performance.
sents.zh: 因此，我们在最简单的仅论文数据池 ’20–’23、’25–’26 ∗ 上进行训练，这在不牺牲文本性能的情况下获得了最强的视觉结果。

paragraphs.en: We also tested several fixed-compute design choices beyond the paper-only input. As Table F.2 c shows, suffixing text with paper statistics or agent-generated Qwen/Gemini reviews can help text modestly, especially on ’26, but none of these additions improves the strongest vision model. The same is true for other fixed-cost variants such as suffixing text with full vision, vision with full text, or prepending 1k <think> tokens. None of these design choices consistently improves performance, so we simply use paper → \to decision prediction.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还测试了超出仅论文输入之外的若干固定计算量设计选择。 如表 F.2 c 所示，在文本后附加论文统计信息或智能体生成的 Qwen/Gemini 评审可以在一定程度上帮助文本模型，尤其是在 ’26 上，但这些附加内容都不能改进最强的视觉模型。 对于其他固定成本变体也是如此，例如在文本后附加完整视觉信息、在视觉后附加完整文本，或在开头添加 1k 个 <think> 词元。 这些设计选择都不能持续地提升性能，因此我们直接使用论文 → \to 决策预测。

sents.en: We also tested several fixed-compute design choices beyond the paper-only input.
sents.zh: 我们还测试了超出仅论文输入之外的若干固定计算量设计选择。

sents.en: As Table F.2 c shows, suffixing text with paper statistics or agent-generated Qwen/Gemini reviews can help text modestly, especially on ’26, but none of these additions improves the strongest vision model.
sents.zh: 如表 F.2 c 所示，在文本后附加论文统计信息或智能体生成的 Qwen/Gemini 评审可以在一定程度上帮助文本模型，尤其是在 ’26 上，但这些附加内容都不能改进最强的视觉模型。

sents.en: The same is true for other fixed-cost variants such as suffixing text with full vision, vision with full text, or prepending 1k <think> tokens.
sents.zh: 对于其他固定成本变体也是如此，例如在文本后附加完整视觉信息、在视觉后附加完整文本，或在开头添加 1k 个 <think> 词元。

sents.en: None of these design choices consistently improves performance, so we simply use paper → \to decision prediction.
sents.zh: 这些设计选择都不能持续地提升性能，因此我们直接使用论文 → \to 决策预测。

paragraphs.en: Paper statistics features. We appended structured metadata such as page count, number of references, inline math count, cross-reference density, and other surface-level features to each training sample. While these features are individually predictive, adding them to the SFT prompt did not improve over the paper-only baseline, suggesting that the language model already captures these signals implicitly from the paper text.
paragraphs.zh: 论文统计特征。 我们为每个训练样本附加了结构化元数据，例如页数、参考文献数量、行内公式数量、交叉引用密度以及其他表层特征。 虽然这些特征各自都具有预测能力，但将它们加入 SFT 提示后并未超过仅使用论文的基线，这表明语言模型已经从论文文本中隐式地捕获了这些信号。

sents.en: Paper statistics features.
sents.zh: 论文统计特征。

sents.en: We appended structured metadata such as page count, number of references, inline math count, cross-reference density, and other surface-level features to each training sample.
sents.zh: 我们为每个训练样本附加了结构化元数据，例如页数、参考文献数量、行内公式数量、交叉引用密度以及其他表层特征。

sents.en: While these features are individually predictive, adding them to the SFT prompt did not improve over the paper-only baseline, suggesting that the language model already captures these signals implicitly from the paper text.
sents.zh: 虽然这些特征各自都具有预测能力，但将它们加入 SFT 提示后并未超过仅使用论文的基线，这表明语言模型已经从论文文本中隐式地捕获了这些信号。

paragraphs.en: Thinking tokens. Inspired by chain-of-thought prompting, we prepended dummy reasoning tokens before the decision token during SFT, allowing the model additional computation before committing to a prediction. This did not improve accuracy, consistent with our finding that the decision task benefits more from pattern recognition over the full paper than from explicit multi-step reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 思考词元。 受思维链提示的启发，我们在 SFT 期间在决策词元之前添加了虚拟推理词元，使模型在做出预测之前有额外的计算机会。 这并没有提升准确率，这与我们的发现一致：决策任务更多受益于对整篇论文的模式识别，而非显式的多步推理。

sents.en: Thinking tokens.
sents.zh: 思考词元。

sents.en: Inspired by chain-of-thought prompting, we prepended dummy reasoning tokens before the decision token during SFT, allowing the model additional computation before committing to a prediction.
sents.zh: 受思维链提示的启发，我们在 SFT 期间在决策词元之前添加了虚拟推理词元，使模型在做出预测之前有额外的计算机会。

sents.en: This did not improve accuracy, consistent with our finding that the decision task benefits more from pattern recognition over the full paper than from explicit multi-step reasoning.
sents.zh: 这并没有提升准确率，这与我们的发现一致：决策任务更多受益于对整篇论文的模式识别，而非显式的多步推理。

paragraphs.en: Multimodal fusion. We tested providing both the full extracted text and screenshots of all pages simultaneously (text + vision), as well as the reverse (vision + text). Neither configuration outperformed the single-modality baselines, likely because the two representations are largely redundant for the decision task, and the additional context length increases noise without adding a complementary signal.
paragraphs.zh: 多模态融合。 我们测试了同时提供完整提取文本和所有页面截图（文本 + 视觉），以及相反的顺序（视觉 + 文本）。 两种配置都没有超过单模态基线，这可能是因为两种表示对于该决策任务而言很大程度上是冗余的，额外的上下文长度增加了噪声却没有带来互补信号。

sents.en: Multimodal fusion.
sents.zh: 多模态融合。

sents.en: We tested providing both the full extracted text and screenshots of all pages simultaneously (text + vision), as well as the reverse (vision + text).
sents.zh: 我们测试了同时提供完整提取文本和所有页面截图（文本 + 视觉），以及相反的顺序（视觉 + 文本）。

sents.en: Neither configuration outperformed the single-modality baselines, likely because the two representations are largely redundant for the decision task, and the additional context length increases noise without adding a complementary signal.
sents.zh: 两种配置都没有超过单模态基线，这可能是因为两种表示对于该决策任务而言很大程度上是冗余的，额外的上下文长度增加了噪声却没有带来互补信号。

paragraphs.en: Synthetic review augmentation. Appending model-generated reviews (Qwen3.5-122B-A10B or Gemini-2.5-Flash) to training prompts added ∼ 1.8 {\sim}1.8 k– 4.8 4.8 k tokens per sample. These reviews occasionally helped on ICLR ’25 but hurt on ICLR ’26, suggesting that review language is more year-specific than paper content and does not transfer reliably.
paragraphs.zh: 合成评审增强。 将模型生成的评审（Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 或 Gemini-2.5-Flash）附加到训练提示中，为每个样本增加了约 1.8k–4.8k 个 token。 这些评审在 ICLR '25 上偶尔有所帮助，但在 ICLR '26 上却造成损害，这表明评审语言比论文内容更具年份特异性，无法可靠地迁移。

sents.en: Synthetic review augmentation.
sents.zh: 合成评审增强。

sents.en: Appending model-generated reviews (Qwen3.5-122B-A10B or Gemini-2.5-Flash) to training prompts added ∼ 1.8 {\sim}1.8 k– 4.8 4.8 k tokens per sample.
sents.zh: 将模型生成的评审（Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 或 Gemini-2.5-Flash）附加到训练提示中，为每个样本增加了约 1.8k–4.8k 个 token。

sents.en: These reviews occasionally helped on ICLR ’25 but hurt on ICLR ’26, suggesting that review language is more year-specific than paper content and does not transfer reliably.
sents.zh: 这些评审在 ICLR '25 上偶尔有所帮助，但在 ICLR '26 上却造成损害，这表明评审语言比论文内容更具年份特异性，无法可靠地迁移。

paragraphs.en: To test whether SFT models rely on positional shortcuts, we reversed the paper order while keeping labels fixed — text examples reverse section blocks, and vision examples reverse page order. Training and evaluating in the same reversed condition only loses about 1–1.3% relative to the forward baseline, and forward-trained checkpoints remain usable on reversed validation inputs (Table F.3 ). This suggests the models are not merely keying on early-section or early-page cues; vision is especially order-invariant.
paragraphs.zh: 为了测试 SFT 模型是否依赖位置捷径，我们在保持标签不变的情况下反转了论文顺序——文本示例反转章节块顺序，视觉示例反转页码顺序。 在相同的反转条件下进行训练和评估，相比正向基线仅损失约 1–1.3%，并且正向训练的检查点在反转的验证输入上仍然可用（表 F.3）。 这表明这些模型并非仅仅依赖早期章节或早期页面的线索；视觉模态尤其具有顺序不变性。

sents.en: To test whether SFT models rely on positional shortcuts, we reversed the paper order while keeping labels fixed — text examples reverse section blocks, and vision examples reverse page order.
sents.zh: 为了测试 SFT 模型是否依赖位置捷径，我们在保持标签不变的情况下反转了论文顺序——文本示例反转章节块顺序，视觉示例反转页码顺序。

sents.en: Training and evaluating in the same reversed condition only loses about 1–1.3% relative to the forward baseline, and forward-trained checkpoints remain usable on reversed validation inputs (Table F.3 ).
sents.zh: 在相同的反转条件下进行训练和评估，相比正向基线仅损失约 1–1.3%，并且正向训练的检查点在反转的验证输入上仍然可用（表 F.3）。

sents.en: This suggests the models are not merely keying on early-section or early-page cues; vision is especially order-invariant.
sents.zh: 这表明这些模型并非仅仅依赖早期章节或早期页面的线索；视觉模态尤其具有顺序不变性。

paragraphs.en: How does a model trained on one source behave on the other? We evaluate the ICLR -trained and arXiv -trained 7B vision models on each source’s test set and on arXiv-ICLR , the ICLR subset of arXiv (Table G.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在某一来源上训练的模型在另一来源上表现如何？ 我们在每个来源的测试集上以及 arXiv-ICLR（即 arXiv 中 ICLR 的子集）上评估了以 ICLR 训练的和以 arXiv 训练的 7B 视觉模型（表 G.1）。

sents.en: How does a model trained on one source behave on the other?
sents.zh: 在某一来源上训练的模型在另一来源上表现如何？

sents.en: We evaluate the ICLR -trained and arXiv -trained 7B vision models on each source’s test set and on arXiv-ICLR , the ICLR subset of arXiv (Table G.1 ).
sents.zh: 我们在每个来源的测试集上以及 arXiv-ICLR（即 arXiv 中 ICLR 的子集）上评估了以 ICLR 训练的和以 arXiv 训练的 7B 视觉模型（表 G.1）。

paragraphs.en: The ICLR -trained model transfers to arXiv-ICLR with no measurable loss (Table G.1 ). With only 105 105 papers, though, its accuracy there has a 95 % 95\% confidence interval that overlaps its in-domain accuracy, so we read this as equal performance, not a real gain. A much larger effect appears when either model is run on the full distribution of the other source. Both become reject-predictive, recovering only about half of the true accepts, so each defaults to rejection on papers that look unfamiliar.
paragraphs.zh: 经过 ICLR 训练的模型迁移到 arXiv-ICLR 时没有可测量的损失（表 G.1）。 不过，由于仅有 105 105 篇论文，其在该数据集上的准确率的 95 % 95\% 置信区间与其域内准确率的置信区间重叠，因此我们将其解读为性能相当，而非真正的提升。 当任一模型在另一来源的完整分布上运行时，会出现大得多的效应。 两者都变得倾向于预测拒稿，只能找回大约一半的真实录用论文，因此对于看起来不熟悉的论文，它们默认给出拒稿预测。

sents.zh: 经过 ICLR 训练的模型迁移到 arXiv-ICLR 时没有可测量的损失（表 G.1）。

sents.en: With only 105 105 papers, though, its accuracy there has a 95 % 95\% confidence interval that overlaps its in-domain accuracy, so we read this as equal performance, not a real gain.

sents.en: Both become reject-predictive, recovering only about half of the true accepts, so each defaults to rejection on papers that look unfamiliar.

paragraphs.en: This is not a threshold problem. We retuned the accept/reject threshold on a small labeled sample from the target source, and it only swapped the error. Accepts then rose above 88 % 88\% while rejects fell below 40 % 40\% , and accuracy stayed flat. Even the best threshold chosen directly on the test labels barely changed it. The model’s ranking of papers, not the threshold, is what fails under the shift.
paragraphs.zh: 这不是一个阈值问题。 我们在来自目标来源的小型标注样本上重新调整了接受/拒绝阈值，但只是让错误发生了互换。 接受率随后升到 88 % 88\% 以上，而拒绝率降到 40 % 40\% 以下，准确率却保持不变。 即使直接在测试标签上选出的最佳阈值也几乎无法改变这一点。 在分布偏移下失效的是模型对论文的排序，而不是阈值。

paragraphs.en: Table H.1 summarizes the prompts, decoding settings, and context limits used across our evaluation suite. Frontier Gemini/GPT models use a single venue-generic rating-plus-decision prompt with high reasoning effort and temperature 1.0 1.0 . Our RL prompt mirrors this setup with temperature 0.7 0.7 . After SFT we decode greedily (temperature 0 0 ). Open-source Qwen baselines use the same prompt family as SFT/RL but at higher temperature to explore prompt corrections, since the base models predict acceptance for almost every paper out of the box. Section H.1 documents each prompt verbatim, Section H.2 reports reasoning-token usage across frontier evaluation cells, and Section H.3 reports the prompt-correction experiments on Qwen and Gemini-2.5-Flash.
paragraphs.zh: 表 H.1 总结了我们在整个评估套件中使用的提示词、解码设置和上下文长度限制。 前沿 Gemini/GPT 模型使用单一的适用于所有会议的评分加决策提示词，推理力度设为高，温度为 1.0 1.0。 我们的 RL 提示词沿用同样的设置，温度为 0.7 0.7。 SFT 之后我们采用贪心解码（温度为 0 0）。 开源 Qwen 基线使用与 SFT/RL 相同的提示词家族，但采用更高的温度以探索提示词修正，因为基础模型开箱即用时几乎对每篇论文都预测接收。 H.1 节逐字记录了每个提示词，H.2 节报告了前沿评估各项设置中的推理 token 使用情况，H.3 节报告了在 Qwen 和 Gemini-2.5-Flash 上的提示词修正实验。

paragraphs.en: [System] You are an expert academic reviewer for the ICLR conference, predicting whether a paper will be accepted or rejected. ICLR generally has a ˜30% acceptance rate. Your response must include two parts: 1. **Reasoning**: A detailed, free-flowing chain of thought enclosed in ‘<think>‘ and ‘</think>‘ tags. 2. **Final Answer**: A single boxed verdict enclosed in ‘<answer>‘ and ‘</answer>‘ tags. * The reasoning should resemble a stream of consciousness: explore, test hypotheses, backtrack if necessary, reflect, and refine. * Use reasoning strategies such as planning, exploration, evaluation, and reflection. * The answer section must be enclosed in ‘<answer>‘ and ‘</answer>‘ tags. * The answer is exactly ‘\boxed{Accept}‘ or ‘\boxed{Reject}‘, with no other text. [User] <paper body as Markdown; vision variant also attaches per-page screenshots>

paragraphs.en: Frontier Reasoning Prompt. Frontier Gemini and GPT models (Gemini-3.1-Pro and GPT-5.5) use a single venue-generic rating-plus-decision prompt for both ICLR and arXiv . We chose this prompt after finding no consistent gain from separate ICLR - and arXiv -specific variants. In practice, the venue is usually recoverable from the paper content and formatting.

paragraphs.en: [System] You are an expert academic ML researcher and reviewer tasked with evaluating research papers. I am giving you a paper submitted to a top machine-learning venue. Predict a rating from 1-10 and the paper’s acceptance outcome. - Your answer will be of the form: \boxed{rating,decision} where rating is an integer in [1,10] and decision is either {Accept, Reject} - Note: typical top-tier ML venues have ˜25-30% acceptance rates [User] <paper body as Markdown; vision variant also attaches per-page screenshots> We use the generated rating as the score, with a higher rating indicating a higher predicted probability of acceptance, and the generated decision as the hard label. In our main results we additionally calibrate the model’s decision using its rating and accuracy performance on the held-out validation set, which generally improves performance.

paragraphs.en: Frontier Reasoning Agent Workspace. Coding-agent baselines use the same Frontier Reasoning Prompt above (carried in AGENTS.override.md ), but place each paper in a self-contained workspace that the agent can inspect with normal file and image tools. The paper body is stripped into paper.md , rendered pages are copied into images/ , and the final answer must be written to PREDICTIONS.json . Both Codex (GPT-5.5) and Claude Code (Sonnet-4.6) run with high reasoning effort, no web tools, and a validator that rejects malformed outputs before grading.

paragraphs.en: Table H.2 reports reasoning-token usage across the four ICLR / arXiv text/vision evaluation cells. Both frontier models spend a substantial amount of reasoning compute per paper. On text inputs, median reasoning tokens land between 1.3 1.3 k and 2.3 2.3 k per paper, and on vision inputs between 1.5 1.5 k and 2.1 2.1 k. P95 reasoning length stretches to 3.6 3.6 k– 4.7 4.7 k, so a non-trivial tail of papers triggers 2 × 2\times or more compute than the median. GPT-5.5 has a lower median than Gemini-3.1-Pro at every cell, but its tail is just as heavy: its P95 sits at 3.6 3.6 k– 4.5 4.5 k against Gemini-3.1-Pro’s 4.1 4.1 k– 4.7 4.7 k, and its P95-to-median ratio is the larger of the two, so its compute varies more from paper to paper. ICLR cells consistently use more reasoning than the matched arXiv cells (e.g. Gemini-3.1-Pro at 2,085 2{,}085 vision-median tokens on ICLR vs 1,825 1{,}825 on arXiv ), suggesting that ICLR papers either look harder or hit prompts that elicit more deliberation.

paragraphs.en: Base open-source models we tested predict acceptance for almost every paper. Out of the box, Qwen2.5-7B with a minimal freeform-boxed prompt accepts more than 99 % 99\% of papers ( Table 3(a) , Freeform Boxed Standard: R A = 99.4 R_{A}=99.4 , R R = 0.9 R_{R}=0.9 ). We therefore tested a range of prompt corrections, few-shot conditioning, and multi-step peer-review emulation across two open-source models (Qwen2.5-7B text and vision, all 2,495 2{,}495 ICLR test papers) and a cheap frontier model (Gemini-2.5-Flash text and vision, a 500 500 -paper stratified subset). All numbers are averages across ’25 and ’26.
paragraphs.zh: 我们测试的基础开源模型几乎对每一篇论文都预测为接收。 开箱即用时，Qwen2.5-7B 配合极简的自由格式框式提示词（freeform-boxed prompt）就会接收超过 99% 的论文（表 3(a)，自由格式框式标准：R_A = 99.4，R_R = 0.9）。 因此，我们在两个开源模型（Qwen2.5-7B 的文本与视觉版本，覆盖全部 2,495 篇 ICLR 测试论文）和一个廉价的前沿模型（Gemini-2.5-Flash 的文本与视觉版本，500 篇论文的分层子集）上，测试了一系列提示词修正、少样本条件化以及多步同行评审模拟方法。 所有数字均为 ’25 年和 ’26 年的平均值。

paragraphs.en: Prompt variants. We compare four prompt formats. Freeform Boxed requests a boxed Accept/Reject answer with no structure. Structured JSON requests a full review schema (summary, strengths, weaknesses, score, decision). Fewshot 1A-1R prepends one accept and one reject calibration example. Fewshot 0A-2R uses two reject examples. Each format can be paired with a Critical modifier (an explicit instruction to be wary of overstated claims and to prefer rejection when uncertain). Multi-turn variants include Majority voting over 5 generations, Meta-Review (the Sequential Refinement of Madaan et al. (2025) ), and PDR Boxed (a single-generation Parallel-Distill-Reflect prompt that runs an Advocate, Critic, and Calibrator inside one rollout).
paragraphs.zh: 提示词变体。 我们比较四种提示词格式。 Freeform Boxed（自由格式加框）要求输出一个加框的接受/拒绝答案，没有任何结构。 Structured JSON（结构化 JSON）要求输出完整的评审模式（摘要、优点、缺点、分数、决定）。 Fewshot 1A-1R（少样本 1 接受 1 拒绝）在前面添加一个接受示例和一个拒绝的校准示例。 Fewshot 0A-2R（少样本 0 接受 2 拒绝）使用两个拒绝示例。 每种格式都可以搭配一个 Critical（批判性）修饰符（一条明确的指令，要求警惕夸大的说法，并在不确定时倾向于拒绝）。 多轮变体包括对 5 个生成结果进行多数投票（Majority voting）、元评审（Meta-Review，即 Madaan 等人的顺序精炼方法， （2025）），以及 PDR Boxed（PDR 加框，一个单轮生成的“并行-蒸馏-反思”提示词，在单次执行中运行一个倡导者智能体、一个批评者智能体和一个校准者智能体）。

paragraphs.en: Critical variant. Appending a single “be critical, prefer rejection when uncertain” instruction is not enough to stop the model from predicting acceptance for nearly every paper. On Qwen2.5-7B text, Freeform Boxed Critical only nudges reject recall from 0.9 % 0.9\% to 4.3 % 4.3\% . Switching to Structured JSON (a full review schema with strengths, weaknesses, score, and decision fields) with the Critical modifier produces a larger swing ( R R = 31.8 % R_{R}=31.8\% for text, 32.1 % 32.1\% for vision), but accuracy stays at chance ( ∼ \sim 50 % 50\% ). Gemini-2.5-Flash predicts acceptance less often to begin with ( R A = 70.2 % R_{A}=70.2\% for text under Freeform Boxed Standard), and adding Critical overshoots, so that it predicts rejection too often ( R R = 75.7 % R_{R}=75.7\% for text, 67.0 % 67.0\% for vision) without changing accuracy. Across both model families, prompting can rebalance accept/reject recall but cannot lift accuracy above the majority baseline.
paragraphs.zh: 批判性变体。 仅附加一条「保持批判性，不确定时倾向于拒稿」的指令，不足以阻止模型对几乎每篇论文都预测接收。 在 Qwen2.5-7B 文本任务上，自由格式带框批判提示（Freeform Boxed Critical）仅将拒稿召回率从 0.9 % 0.9\% 提升到 4.3 % 4.3\% 。 换用结构化 JSON（包含优点、缺点、分数和决定字段的完整评审模式）并配合批判性修饰后，变化更大（文本的 R R = 31.8 % R_{R}=31.8\% ，视觉为 32.1 % 32.1\% ），但准确率仍停留在随机水平（ ∼ \sim 50 % 50\% ）。 Gemini-2.5-Flash 本身预测接收的频率就较低（自由格式带框标准提示下文本的 R A = 70.2 % R_{A}=70.2\% ），而加入批判性修饰后会矫枉过正，导致其预测拒稿过于频繁（文本的 R R = 75.7 % R_{R}=75.7\% ，视觉为 67.0 % 67.0\% ），且准确率没有变化。 在两个模型家族中，提示工程可以重新平衡接收/拒稿召回率，但无法将准确率提升到多数类基线之上。

paragraphs.en: Multi-step peer-review emulation. Multi-turn variants that simulate a reviewer panel, including 5-generation Majority voting, Sequential Refinement Meta-Review ( Madaan et al., 2025 ) , and the single-generation Parallel-Distill-Reflect (PDR) prompt with Advocate, Critic, and Calibrator roles, move recall but not accuracy. Majority voting on Freeform Critical preserves Qwen’s single-turn tendency to accept nearly everything ( R A = 97.3 R_{A}=97.3 , R R = 4.9 R_{R}=4.9 ). Few-shot 1A-1R Standard with Majority voting partially rebalances ( R A = 47.5 R_{A}=47.5 , R R = 59.1 R_{R}=59.1 ), and PDR Boxed reaches R A = 65.1 R_{A}=65.1 , R R = 35.2 R_{R}=35.2 . None of these multi-turn prompts breaks the ∼ \sim 50 % 50\% ceiling on ICLR , consistent with our main-text observation that base-model prompting alone does not recover the decision signal that SFT later captures from the same backbones.
paragraphs.zh: 多步同行评审模拟。 多轮变体模拟评审团，包括 5 代多数投票、顺序精炼元评审（Madaan et al., 2025），以及带有倡导者、批评者和校准者角色的单代并行蒸馏反思（PDR）提示，这些方法提升了召回率但未能提升准确率。 在自由格式批判（Freeform Critical）上的多数投票保留了 Qwen 几乎接受所有内容的单轮倾向（R_A = 97.3，R_R = 4.9）。 带多数投票的少样本 1A-1R 标准提示部分地重新平衡了结果（R_A = 47.5，R_R = 59.1），而 PDR Boxed 达到 R_A = 65.1、R_R = 35.2。 这些多轮提示均未突破 ICLR 上约 50% 的上限，这与正文中的观察一致：仅靠基础模型提示无法恢复 SFT 后续从相同骨干模型中捕捉到的决策信号。

paragraphs.en: Model size ablation. To check whether, with a stronger base model, scale helps prompting (Qwen3.5 is generally stronger than the Qwen2.5 family we have been using), we evaluated the Qwen3.5 family ( 9 9 B, 27 27 B, 35 35 B-MoE, 122 122 B-MoE) under Freeform Boxed Standard on a 500 500 -paper ICLR subset ( Table 3(d) ). Scale alone does not consistently lift base prompting above chance. Even at 122 122 B vision, the strongest cell only reaches 63.2 % 63.2\% / 56.6 % 56.6\% Acc on ’25/’26, well below the SFT and RL models reported in the main text.
paragraphs.zh: 模型规模消融实验。 为了检验在更强的基座模型下，规模是否有助于提示方法（Qwen3.5 总体上强于我们一直使用的 Qwen2.5 系列），我们在一个包含 500 500 篇论文的 ICLR 子集上，以 Freeform Boxed Standard 设置评估了 Qwen3.5 系列（ 9 9 B、27 27 B、35 35 B-MoE、122 122 B-MoE）（表 3(d) ）。 仅靠规模扩大并不能持续将基座模型的提示性能提升到随机水平之上。 即使是 122 122 B 的视觉模型，最强单元格在 '25/'26 上也只达到 63.2 % 63.2\% / 56.6 % 56.6\% 的准确率，远低于正文中报告的 SFT 和 RL 模型。

paragraphs.en: SFT uses cosine decay with 5 warmup steps, context length 24,480 tokens, and greedy evaluation. The strongest text configuration uses batch size 32 with a learning rate of 10 − 6 10^{-6} . The strongest vision configuration uses batch size 16 with the same learning rate. We sweep ICLR and arXiv training sources, 50/50 versus natural-rate class priors, data scale, text versus screenshot inputs, text+vision variants, and suffixes containing structured paper statistics or Qwen/Gemini-generated reviews. For vision efficiency, we also test the panel setup in Table 4 , which tiles ten pages into one 2380 × \times 1512 image. Unless a row is explicitly marked otherwise, 3B SFT runs train for 4 epochs and 7B/14B SFT runs train for 2 epochs.
paragraphs.zh: SFT 采用余弦衰减调度，5 个预热步，上下文长度为 24,480 个 token，并使用贪心解码进行评估。 最强的文本配置使用批量大小 32，学习率为 10 − 6 10^{-6}。 最强的视觉配置使用批量大小 16，学习率相同。 我们对 ICLR 与 arXiv 训练数据来源、50/50 与自然比例的类别先验、数据规模、文本与截图输入、文本+视觉变体，以及包含结构化论文统计信息或由 Qwen/Gemini 生成的评论的后缀进行了扫描对比。 出于视觉效率考虑，我们还测试了表 4 中的面板设置，该设置将十页内容拼接为一张 2380 × \times 1512 的图像。 除非某一行明确标注为其他设置，3B 的 SFT 运行训练 4 个 epoch，7B/14B 的 SFT 运行训练 2 个 epoch。

paragraphs.en: We train two single-turn GRPO policies following DeepSeek-R1 ( Guo et al., 2025 ) , one text and one vision-language, on ICLR . Both apply the reasoning prompt variant from Appendix H.1 on the base Qwen2.5-7B (text) and Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct (vision) models, and use the composite accuracy-plus-format reward described in the main text. Figure I.1 shows training trajectories through step 100 100 on a 1,667-paper held-out ’25/’26 ICLR test set. Both policies show graded reward climbing during training, but the per-class recall panel exposes that the underlying accept/reject mix barely shifts. As the models learn to satisfy the format reward, their pre-existing accept bias is preserved and even tightens further during RL. Neither policy surpasses the strongest SFT model from the main text. The graded reward partially hides the swing because every well-formed prediction already earns a 0.2 0.2 format floor before the decision term contributes anything.
paragraphs.zh: 我们遵循 DeepSeek-R1（Guo et al., 2025）在 ICLR 上训练两个单轮 GRPO 智能体，一个基于文本，一个基于视觉-语言。 两者均在基础模型 Qwen2.5-7B（文本）和 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct（视觉）上应用附录 H.1 中的推理提示变体，并使用正文中描述的准确率加格式的复合奖励。 图 I.1 展示了在一个由 1,667 篇论文构成的 ’25/’26 ICLR 留出测试集上训练至第 100 步的训练轨迹。 两个智能体在训练过程中都显示出分档奖励的持续攀升，但各类别召回率面板揭示出其底层的接收/拒绝比例几乎没有变化。 随着模型学会满足格式奖励，其原有的接收偏置被保留，甚至在强化学习过程中进一步收紧。 两个智能体均未超越正文中最强的 SFT 模型。 分档奖励部分掩盖了这一摆动，因为每个格式良好的预测在决策项产生任何贡献之前就已经获得了 0.2 的格式保底分。

paragraphs.en: Modern neural networks are often poorly calibrated, producing confidence estimates that do not reflect true correctness probabilities ( Guo et al., 2017 ) . We apply post-hoc temperature scaling to our SFT models and to Jev, with a base-rate term so the probabilities hold at a venue’s real acceptance rate.
paragraphs.zh: 现代神经网络往往校准不佳，其产生的置信度估计并不能反映真实的正确概率（Guo et al., 2017）。 我们对 SFT 模型和 Jev 应用事后温度缩放，并加入基础比率项，使概率在实际录用率下依然成立。

sents.en: Modern neural networks are often poorly calibrated, producing confidence estimates that do not reflect true correctness probabilities ( Guo et al., 2017 ) .

sents.en: We apply post-hoc temperature scaling to our SFT models and to Jev, with a base-rate term so the probabilities hold at a venue’s real acceptance rate.
sents.zh: 我们对 SFT 模型和 Jev 应用事后温度缩放，并加入基础比率项，使概率在实际录用率下依然成立。

paragraphs.en: where σ \sigma is the sigmoid function. τ > 1 \tau>1 softens overconfident predictions and τ < 1 \tau<1 sharpens them. We fit τ \tau by minimizing the negative log-likelihood (NLL) on the natural-rate validation split, with π \pi set to that split’s acceptance rate ( 31 % 31\% for ICLR , 23 % 23\% for arXiv ), so the shift absorbs the base rate and τ \tau only sets how sharp the probabilities are. On a balanced set π = 0.5 \pi=0.5 and the shift vanishes. Jev’s scores already sit near the real acceptance rate, so we fit its τ \tau without the shift and, on balanced sets, subtract log ⁡ ( π / ( 1 − π ) ) \log(\pi/(1-\pi)) instead. Since p cal ≥ π p_{\mathrm{cal}}\geq\pi exactly when ℓ ≥ 0 \ell\geq 0 , neither τ \tau nor the shift ever changes a decision.
paragraphs.zh: 其中 σ \sigma 是 sigmoid 函数。τ > 1 \tau>1 会软化过度自信的预测，而 τ < 1 \tau<1 会使其更尖锐。 我们通过在自然接受率验证集划分上最小化负对数似然（NLL）来拟合 τ \tau，其中 π \pi 设为该划分的接受率（ ICLR 为 31 % 31\%，arXiv 为 23 % 23\%），因此该平移项吸收了基础接受率，而 τ \tau 只决定概率的尖锐程度。 在均衡集上 π = 0.5 \pi=0.5，该平移项消失。 Jev 的分数本身就接近真实接受率，因此我们在拟合其 τ \tau 时不使用平移项，而在均衡集上改为减去 log ⁡ ( π / ( 1 − π ) ) \log(\pi/(1-\pi))。 由于当且仅当 ℓ ≥ 0 \ell\geq 0 时 p cal ≥ π p_{\mathrm{cal}}\geq\pi，因此无论是 τ \tau 还是平移项都不会改变任何判定结果。

paragraphs.en: We do not minimize ECE directly because (i) the binning operation is non-differentiable, (ii) ECE is sensitive to the number of bins, and (iii) NLL is a strictly proper scoring rule whose global optimum is achieved if and only if predicted probabilities equal true probabilities. ECE, by contrast, can be zero even with poorly separated and rank-uninformative predictions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们不直接最小化 ECE，原因在于：(i) 分箱操作不可微，(ii) ECE 对分箱数量敏感，以及 (iii) NLL 是一种严格真评分规则，当且仅当预测概率等于真实概率时才达到全局最优。 相比之下，即使预测的区分度差且排序信息量低，ECE 仍可能为零。

paragraphs.en: Calibration at the real acceptance rate. On a natural-rate set we measure the calibration of the acceptance probability itself: we bin papers by p cal p_{\mathrm{cal}} into ten equal-width bins on [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] and take the size-weighted gap between each bin’s mean p cal p_{\mathrm{cal}} and the fraction of its papers actually accepted. Table I.1 and Figure I.2 evaluate the shift on the natural-rate test sets. Without it, the probabilities stay centered for a 50/50 world and overstate acceptance (ECE .13 .13 – .15 .15 ). With it, ECE falls to .023 .023 – .042 .042 for PaperScorer . At this rate an ICLR Accept call by PaperScorer -Vision is right 47 % 47\% of the time and a Reject call 82 % 82\% ( 56 % 56\% and 91 % 91\% on arXiv ). The shifted probabilities slightly understate acceptance: their mean is 29.3 % 29.3\% where 31.3 % 31.3\% of ICLR papers are accepted, and 21.8 % 21.8\% where 24.8 % 24.8\% of arXiv papers are.
paragraphs.zh: 在真实录用率下的校准。 在自然率集合上，我们测量录用概率本身的校准情况：我们将论文按 p_{\mathrm{cal}} 在 [0,1] 上划分为十个等宽区间，并计算每个区间的 p_{\mathrm{cal}} 均值与该区间论文实际被录用比例之间按规模加权的差距。 表 I.1 和图 I.2 在自然率测试集上评估了这种平移。 若不做平移，概率仍以 50/50 的世界为中心，并高估录用率（ECE 为 .13–.15）。 平移后，PaperScorer 的 ECE 降至 .023–.042。 在该率下，PaperScorer-Vision 作出的 ICLR Accept 判断有 47% 的时候是正确的，Reject 判断有 82% 正确（在 arXiv 上分别为 56% 和 91%）。 平移后的概率略微低估录用率：其均值为 29.3%，而 ICLR 论文的实际录用率为 31.3%；均值为 21.8% 时，arXiv 论文的实际录用率为 24.8%。

paragraphs.en: Robustness. Fitting τ \tau on a balanced validation split instead, and adding the same shift, gives similar results (ECE .030 .030 – .049 .049 ). A two-parameter Platt fit ( Platt, 1999 ) , σ ⁡ ( a ​ ℓ + b ) \sigma(a\ell+b) on the natural-rate split, is slightly better still ( 0.017 0.017 – 0.031 0.031 ) and also calibrates Jev ( 0.018 0.018 – 0.021 0.021 ). paragraphs.en: For uncertainty estimates, we use paired bootstrap resampling so each resample compares models on the same papers. We resample paper IDs 10,000 times with replacement and recompute Acc and AUC on each resample. Table J.1 reports percentile 95% two-sided CIs for the four headline PaperScorer -Vision comparisons. On ICLR , the Acc gap against Gemini-3.1-Pro is + 3.8 % +3.8\% with CI [ + 0.4 , + 7.3 ] [+0.4,+7.3] , and the AUC gap against GPT-5.5 is + .066 +.066 with CI [ + .034 , + .098 ] [+.034,+.098] . On arXiv , the Acc gap against Gemini-3.1-Pro is + 8.7 % +8.7\% (CI [ + 4.5 , + 12.7 ] [+4.5,+12.7] ) and the AUC gap against GPT-5.5 is + .097 +.097 (CI [ + .061 , + .135 ] [+.061,+.135] ). Since our claim is directional, we test it one-sided; all four are significant ( p ≤ .014 p\leq.014 ). The same holds for every large frontier configuration: against Gemini-3.1-Pro and GPT-5.5 with either text or vision input, with decisions thresholded as in Table 3 , the one-sided p p is below .05 .05 for both Acc and AUC on both datasets (largest p = .040 p=.040 , Acc against GPT-5.5 with text input on ICLR ).
paragraphs.zh: 对于不确定性估计，我们使用配对自助重采样，因此每次重采样都在同一批论文上比较各模型。 我们对论文 ID 进行 10,000 次有放回重采样，并在每次重采样上重新计算 Acc 和 AUC。 表 J.1 报告了四个核心 PaperScorer -Vision 对比的双侧 95% 百分位置信区间。 在 ICLR 上，相对于 Gemini-3.1-Pro 的 Acc 差距为 + 3.8 % +3.8\%（置信区间为 [ + 0.4 , + 7.3 ] [+0.4,+7.3] ），相对于 GPT-5.5 的 AUC 差距为 + .066 +.066（置信区间为 [ + .034 , + .098 ] [+.034,+.098] ）。 在 arXiv 上，相对于 Gemini-3.1-Pro 的 Acc 差距为 + 8.7 % +8.7\%（置信区间为 [ + 4.5 , + 12.7 ] [+4.5,+12.7] ），相对于 GPT-5.5 的 AUC 差距为 + .097 +.097（置信区间为 [ + .061 , + .135 ] [+.061,+.135] ）。 由于我们的主张是方向性的，我们采用单侧检验；四项检验均显著（ p ≤ .014 p\leq.014 ）。 这一点对所有大型前沿配置同样成立：在以与表 3 相同的方式对决策进行阈值化的条件下，无论使用文本还是视觉输入与 Gemini-3.1-Pro 和 GPT-5.5 对比，两个数据集上 Acc 和 AUC 的单侧 p p 值均低于 .05 .05 （最大 p = .040 p=.040 ，为在 ICLR 上以文本输入对比 GPT-5.5 时的 Acc）。

paragraphs.en: Table J.2 compares vision with text on each dataset using the same bootstrap framework. Vision beats text in five of the six comparisons. We test this formally only for PaperScorer : its vision and text models are scored on the same papers, and vision is significantly better on both datasets ( p = .012 p=.012 and .005 .005 , one-sided, corrected for the two tests with Holm–Bonferroni). For the frontier models we report the gaps for reference only. Once their decisions are thresholded as in Table 3 , the gaps range from − 1.0 -1.0 to + 2.3 +2.3 , and none is statistically significant.
paragraphs.zh: 表 J.2 使用相同的自助法框架，在各个数据集上将视觉与文本进行了比较。 在六组比较中，视觉有五组胜过文本。 我们仅对 PaperScorer 进行正式检验：其视觉模型与文本模型在同一批论文上进行评分，视觉模型在两个数据集上都显著更优（p = .012 和 .005，单侧检验，并用 Holm–Bonferroni 方法对两次检验进行了校正）。 对于前沿模型，我们仅报告差距作为参考。 一旦按照表 3 的方式对它们的决策进行阈值化处理，差距范围从 −1.0 到 +2.3，且没有一个是统计显著的。

paragraphs.en: Correlative analysis. Binary accept/reject training yields a continuous score that also tracks reviewer ratings and later citations. On ICLR , PaperScorer -Vision has the strongest PaperScorer rating alignment ( ρ R = + .48 \rho_{R}=+.48 ), while PaperScorer -Text at 14B is strongest within PaperScorer for ’25 citation alignment ( ρ C = + .31 \rho_{C}=+.31 ). On arXiv , reviewer ratings and citations are available for fewer papers than decisions are, so we treat them as diagnostics and leave them out of the headline comparisons. On ICLR ’25, the one slice with both full reviewer ratings and citations ( n = 678 n=678 ), PaperScorer -Vision’s p accept p_{\mathrm{accept}} tracks later citations about as well as the human review score ( ρ ≈ .25 \rho\approx.25 vs. .26 .26 ), and accepted papers outcite rejected ones (citation AUC .64 .64 ). We cannot run this check on arXiv , whose citations come only from proceedings-matched accepts, leaving too few rejected papers to compare.
paragraphs.zh: 相关性分析。 二元的接受/拒绝式训练能产生一个连续分数，该分数同样能追踪审稿人评分和后续引用。 在 ICLR 上，PaperScorer-Vision 与 PaperScorer 评分的一致性最强（ρ_R = +.48），而 14B 的 PaperScorer-Text 在 PaperScorer 中对 '25 年引用的一致性最强（ρ_C = +.31）。 在 arXiv 上，有审稿人评分和引用的论文比有录用决定的论文少，因此我们将这两者视为诊断性指标，而不纳入主要比较。 在 ICLR '25 上唯一同时具备完整审稿人评分和引用数据的切片（n = 678）中，PaperScorer-Vision 的 p_accept 对后续引用的追踪能力与人类评审分数大致相当（ρ ≈ .25 对 .26），且被接受的论文引用量高于被拒绝的论文（引用 AUC 为 .64）。 我们无法在 arXiv 上进行这一检验，因为其引用仅来自与会议论文集匹配的录用论文，被拒绝的论文数量太少而无法比较。

paragraphs.en: Frontier model repeatability. We repeated a subset of the frontier-model inference calls on the same held-out arXiv -text papers to estimate run-to-run noise. GPT-5.4 is almost deterministic under the same prompt, while Gemini-3.1-Pro has meaningful stochasticity. Decision agreement is 89.4% and the second pass is 4.5% lower on the same papers (Table J.3 ). We therefore treat GPT-5.4 point estimates as stable, while Gemini estimates should be read with several points of implicit run noise unless repeated passes are averaged. This repeatability audit was run on GPT-5.4, the frontier model used before we re-ran the main GPT baseline on GPT-5.5; we did not separately re-audit GPT-5.5’s run-to-run noise.
paragraphs.zh: 前沿模型的可重复性。 我们对同一批留出的 arXiv 文本论文重复了一部分前沿模型推理调用，以估计运行间的噪声。 GPT-5.4 在相同提示词下几乎是确定性的，而 Gemini-3.1-Pro 则具有明显的随机性。 决策一致率为 89.4%，且第二轮在同一批论文上低了 4.5%（表 J.3）。 因此，我们将 GPT-5.4 的点估计视为稳定的，而 Gemini 的估计则应视为带有若干点的隐含运行噪声，除非对多次重复运行取平均。 这项可重复性审计是在 GPT-5.4 上运行的，GPT-5.4 是我们在 GPT-5.5 上重新运行主要 GPT 基线之前使用的前沿模型；我们没有对 GPT-5.5 的运行间噪声进行单独的重新审计。

paragraphs.en: PaperScorer produces a ranking signal that is empirically proven: its high AUC and rating correlation show that the score ranks accepted papers above rejected ones and agrees with reviewer ratings, and temperature scaling makes that score calibrated after the fact. This invites two applications where a calibrated estimate of acceptance probability matters. In literature retrieval, we want to surface work likely to be accepted among topically similar candidates. In agentic reviewing, a generated critique relies on a well-calibrated prior over the final decision. We study both settings below.
paragraphs.zh: PaperScorer 产生一种经过实证验证的排序信号：其高 AUC 和评分相关性表明，该分数能将被接收的论文排在被拒稿的论文之前，并与审稿人的评分一致，且温度缩放（temperature scaling）使该分数在事后得到校准。 这引出了两个需要对接收概率进行校准估计的应用场景。 在文献检索中，我们希望在主题相似的候选文献中突出那些很可能被接收的工作。 在智能体审稿中，生成的审稿意见依赖于对最终决策的一个良好校准的先验。 我们将在下文研究这两种场景。

paragraphs.en: Scientific search systems must retrieve a target paper from many plausible topical matches. LitSearch ( Ajith et al., 2024 ) captures this setting with natural-language literature queries paired with one or more gold cited papers. We evaluate the subset linked to our arXiv pool: 478 queries have at least one gold arXiv paper, and 250 have all gold arXiv IDs inside the PaperScorer arXiv corpus. To isolate the regime where reranking matters, we use the 148 hard queries for which BM25 has zero Recall@5, covering 150 gold papers.
paragraphs.zh: 科学检索系统必须从许多主题相近的候选文献中检索出目标论文。 LitSearch（Ajith et al., 2024）通过自然语言的文献查询与一篇或多篇标准答案被引论文配对来刻画这一场景。 我们评估与我们的 arXiv 语料库相关联的子集：478 个查询至少有一篇标准答案 arXiv 论文，其中 250 个查询的所有标准答案 arXiv ID 都在 PaperScorer 的 arXiv 语料库内。 为了隔离重排序起作用的场景，我们使用 BM25 的 Recall@5 为零的 148 个困难查询，覆盖 150 篇标准答案论文。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval supplies the topical neighborhood, while PaperScorer -Vision reorders candidates by their estimated acceptance probability. Figure K.1 shows that this helps both retrievers: whether candidates come from sparse BM25 or a dense Qwen embedding, reranking pulls more of the gold cited papers toward the top of the list. The gain is largest near the top, where retrieval has already gathered topically similar work and the only open question is which paper is more likely to be accepted. Deeper down, where topical relevance still does most of the sorting, the prior adds little, so PaperScorer -Vision acts as a prior on acceptance layered on retrieval, not a substitute for it.
paragraphs.zh: 检索提供了主题上相近的邻域，而 PaperScorer -Vision 则根据估计的录用概率对候选文献进行重排序。 图 K.1 显示这对两种检索器都有帮助：无论候选文献来自稀疏的 BM25 还是稠密的 Qwen 嵌入，重排序都能把更多被引用的金标论文拉到列表顶部。 增益在排名靠前的位置最大，因为此时检索已经收集到主题相似的工作，唯一悬而未决的问题只是哪篇论文更可能被录用。 而在更靠后的位置，主题相关性仍然是排序的主要因素，该先验几乎不起作用，因此 PaperScorer -Vision 是叠加在检索之上的录用先验，而非其替代品。

paragraphs.en: Prior work shows that LLM reviews can yield actionable suggestions for improving papers ( Thakkar et al., 2026 ) , but our prompt-tuning results ( Section 4.3 ) suggest that the predicted decisions poorly track ground-truth outcomes. As noted in Section 2 , papers X X are transformed into reviews R R before reaching a decision Z Z , so the joint distribution over reviews and decisions factors as p ⁡ ( R , Z ∣ X ) p(R,Z\mid X) . While the autoregressive flow places the review before the decision, now that we have built a shortcut that predicts the decision without the review, we can ask whether we can generate more decision-calibrated reviews by rearranging the joint:
paragraphs.zh: 先前的研究表明，大语言模型的评审能够为改进论文提供可行的建议（Thakkar et al., 2026），但我们的提示词调优结果（第4.3节）表明，预测的决策与真实结果的一致性较差。 如第2节所述，论文 X X 在到达决策 Z Z 之前会先被转化为评审 R R，因此评审与决策的联合分布可分解为 p ⁡ ( R , Z ∣ X ) p(R,Z\mid X)。 虽然自回归流将评审置于决策之前，但既然我们已经构建了一个无需评审即可预测决策的捷径，我们可以追问：能否通过重新排列联合分布来生成与决策更校准一致的评审？

paragraphs.en: Both factorizations are valid. Conceptually, if our conjecture is correct — that much of the decision is determined by overall presentation quality — then reviews may serve as a means-to-an-end to justify the reviewer’s initial reaction. This follows from psychology research on human decision-making, whereby we often rely on initial judgments and post-hoc rationalization more than we consciously attribute ( Nisbett and Wilson, 1977 ; Kunda, 1990 ; Haidt, 2001 ) , with low-level feelings of “goodness” or “badness” driving longer-form judgments and reasoning ( Slovic et al., 2007 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 两种因式分解都是有效的。 从概念上讲，如果我们的猜想是正确的——即决策在很大程度上由整体展示质量决定——那么评审可能只是作为证明评审者初始反应的合理化手段。 这一点可以从关于人类决策的心理学研究中得到印证：我们往往更多依赖初始判断和事后合理化，而非我们有意识所认为的程度（Nisbett and Wilson, 1977；Kunda, 1990；Haidt, 2001），“好”或“坏”这类低层次感受驱动着更长的判断与推理过程（Slovic et al., 2007）。

sents.en: Both factorizations are valid.
sents.zh: 两种因式分解都是有效的。

sents.en: Conceptually, if our conjecture is correct — that much of the decision is determined by overall presentation quality — then reviews may serve as a means-to-an-end to justify the reviewer’s initial reaction.
sents.zh: 从概念上讲，如果我们的猜想是正确的——即决策在很大程度上由整体展示质量决定——那么评审可能只是作为证明评审者初始反应的合理化手段。

sents.en: This follows from psychology research on human decision-making, whereby we often rely on initial judgments and post-hoc rationalization more than we consciously attribute ( Nisbett and Wilson, 1977 ; Kunda, 1990 ; Haidt, 2001 ) , with low-level feelings of “goodness” or “badness” driving longer-form judgments and reasoning ( Slovic et al., 2007 ) .
sents.zh: 这一点可以从关于人类决策的心理学研究中得到印证：我们往往更多依赖初始判断和事后合理化，而非我们有意识所认为的程度（Nisbett and Wilson, 1977；Kunda, 1990；Haidt, 2001），“好”或“坏”这类低层次感受驱动着更长的判断与推理过程（Slovic et al., 2007）。

paragraphs.en: We therefore ask whether conditioning frontier coding agents on the PaperScorer signal can (1) improve their decision-prediction and (2) improve their generated reviews’ alignment with human reviews. We use PaperScorer -Vision as the calibrated prior, and let Claude Code write the review.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们探究以 PaperScorer 信号为条件来约束前沿编码智能体，能否（1）提升其决策预测能力，以及（2）提升其生成的评审与人类评审的一致性。 我们使用 PaperScorer-Vision 作为校准后的先验，并让 Claude Code 撰写评审。

sents.en: We therefore ask whether conditioning frontier coding agents on the PaperScorer signal can (1) improve their decision-prediction and (2) improve their generated reviews’ alignment with human reviews.
sents.zh: 因此，我们探究以 PaperScorer 信号为条件来约束前沿编码智能体，能否（1）提升其决策预测能力，以及（2）提升其生成的评审与人类评审的一致性。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Claude Code (Sonnet-4.6) on 500 ICLR papers. The agent receives PaperScorer -Vision’s decision, p accept p_{\mathrm{accept}} , and confidence bands, and can inspect text, rendered pages, and the temporally filtered arXiv retrieval. It emits a schema-constrained review and decision. Codex (GPT-5.5, medium reasoning) grades reviews against human reviews (review generation and alignment grading prompts in Appendix K.3 ).

paragraphs.en: Table 1(a) shows that Claude alone underperforms PaperScorer -Vision, but adding the calibrated prior improves overall accuracy from 63.0% to 70.6%, surpassing both individually. This matches the factorization above. PaperScorer -Vision anchors the decision while the reviewer supplies the critique. The gain comes mainly from a 13.6% subset of papers flipping Accept → \to Reject at 77.9% accuracy ( Table 1(b) ). Reject → \to Accept flips are rarer and much less reliable. Although Claude predicts rejection more often than acceptance on the balanced evaluation ( Table 3 ), on this 30/70 subset its remaining incorrect acceptance predictions dominate the correction signal, which the calibrated accept probability catches by pulling those papers below the decision threshold the agent then respects.
paragraphs.zh: 表1(a)显示，单独使用Claude的表现不如PaperScorer-Vision，但加入校准后的先验可将整体准确率从63.0%提升至70.6%，超过两者各自的单独表现。 这与上述的因子分解相吻合。 PaperScorer-Vision为决策提供锚定，而智能体（Claude）提供评审意见。 这一提升主要来自13.6%的论文子集在77.9%的准确率下从Accept翻转为Reject（表1(b)）。 Reject翻转为Accept的情况更少见，且可靠性也低得多。 尽管在平衡评估集上Claude预测拒稿的频率高于接收（表3），但在这个30/70的子集上，其剩余的错误接收预测主导了纠正信号，而校准后的接收概率通过将这些论文的得分拉低到决策阈值以下捕捉到了这一信号，智能体随后会遵循该阈值。

paragraphs.en: Conditioning on PaperScorer -Vision also improves alignment with human reviews across every factor except contributions ( Table 1(a) ). Because the prior corrects Claude’s accept-bias, the agent emits weakness and novelty critiques at a higher rate, bringing the generated review closer to the human ground truth. Contribution alignment was already saturated under Claude alone, and is preserved under conditioning.
paragraphs.zh: 在 PaperScorer-Vision 上进行条件化也能提升与人类评审在除贡献（contributions）之外所有因素上的对齐（表 1(a)）。 由于先验校正了 Claude 的接受偏见，该智能体以更高的频率输出关于不足和新颖性的批评意见，使生成的评审更接近人类基准真值。 贡献对齐在仅使用 Claude 时已经饱和，在条件化下得以保持。

paragraphs.en: You are an expert meta-reviewer evaluating AI-generated paper reviews against real ICLR human reviews and the Area Chair (AC) metareview. For each paper you will see: - "human_reviews": individual ICLR reviewer assessments - "metareview": the AC’s decision comment summarizing why the paper was accepted/rejected - "agent_review": the AI-generated review to evaluate EVALUATION PROTOCOL -- for EACH dimension, you MUST: 1. QUOTE the relevant text from human reviews / metareview (use "..." for excerpts) 2. QUOTE the relevant text from the agent review 3. Explain your reasoning comparing the two 4. Assign a score 1-5 DIMENSIONS: 1. contribution_identification (1-5): What is the primary contribution according to human reviewers? Did the agent identify the same core contribution? - 5: Agent identifies the exact same core contribution with similar framing - 4: Same contribution but framed differently or missing a key aspect - 3: Related but focuses on a secondary contribution instead of the primary one - 2: Vaguely related to the actual contribution - 1: Completely different contribution identified, or contribution not discussed 2. top_weakness_identification (1-5): What is the #1 weakness from human reviews? (The one most reviewers agree on, or that the AC highlights in the metareview.) Did the agent identify this specific weakness? - 5: Agent identifies the same top weakness with comparable specificity and detail - 4: Identifies the weakness but less precisely, or conflates it with other issues - 3: Mentions the general area of concern but misses the specific technical point - 2: Identifies only minor or tangential weaknesses, misses the critical one entirely - 1: No meaningful overlap with human-identified weaknesses 3. novel_concerns (1-5): List any concerns the agent raises that are NOT present in human reviews or metareview. Are these valid and substantive? - 5: Raises 2+ valid, substantive technical concerns that humans missed - 4: Raises 1 valid substantive concern that humans missed - 3: Raises concerns that are valid but minor, obvious, or not very useful - 2: Novel concerns are mostly invalid, confused, or based on misunderstanding the paper - 1: No novel concerns raised, or all novel points are factually wrong 4. overall_review_quality (1-5): Holistic quality considering: summary accuracy, weakness depth, strength identification, constructiveness, specificity.
paragraphs.zh: 你是一名专家元审稿人，任务是对照真实的 ICLR 人类评审和领域主席（AC）的元评审，评估 AI 生成的论文评审。 对于每篇论文，你将看到：- “human_reviews”：ICLR 各位评审人的个人评估 - “metareview”：AC 的决策评论，总结论文被接收/拒绝的原因 - “agent_review”：待评估的 AI 生成评审。评估协议 —— 对于每个维度，你必须：1. 引用人类评审/元评审中的相关文本（摘录使用 "..." 标注）2. 引用智能体评审中的相关文本 3. 解释你比较两者后的推理 4. 给出 1-5 分的评分。维度：1. contribution_identification（1-5）：根据人类评审，论文的主要贡献是什么？ 智能体是否识别出了相同的核心贡献？- 5：智能体以相似的表述识别出完全相同的核心贡献 - 4：贡献相同但表述不同，或遗漏了关键方面 - 3：相关但聚焦于次要贡献而非主要贡献 - 2：与实际贡献仅有模糊关联 - 1：识别出的贡献完全不同，或完全没有讨论贡献 2. top_weakness_identification（1-5）：人类评审中的头号弱点是什么？ （即大多数评审人认同的、或 AC 在元评审中着重指出的那个弱点。）智能体是否识别出了这一具体弱点？- 5：智能体以相当的针对性和细节识别出相同的头号弱点 - 4：识别出该弱点但不够精确，或将其与其他问题混淆 - 3：提及了一般性的关注领域，但遗漏了具体的技术要点 - 2：只识别出次要或边缘的弱点，完全遗漏了关键弱点 - 1：与人类识别出的弱点没有任何实质性重合 3. novel_concerns（1-5）：列出智能体提出的、但人类评审或元评审中不存在的任何关切。 这些关切是否有效且具有实质内容？- 5：提出 2 个以上人类遗漏的、有效且有实质内容的技术性关切 - 4：提出 1 个人类遗漏的、有效的实质性关切 - 3：提出的关切有效但属于次要、显而易见或用处不大 - 2：新提出的关切大多无效、混乱，或基于对论文的误解 - 1：没有提出任何新关切，或所有新观点在事实层面都是错误的 4. overall_review_quality（1-5）：综合考虑以下方面的整体质量：摘要准确性、弱点分析的深度、优点识别、建设性、具体性。

paragraphs.en: We attribute the decision of PaperScorer to specific input features. Using metadata from MinerU, we divide each paper into 5 sections: Introduction, Background, Methodology, Experiments (including Results), and Discussion (including Conclusion). Using the final decision token’s last-layer attention as a descriptive map (described in Appendix L.2 ), we observe a clear hierarchical preference as seen in Table L.1 . Generally, attention increases later in the paper. However, the introduction is weighed more heavily than the background. We visualize examples in Figure L.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 PaperScorer 的决策归因到具体的输入特征上。 利用 MinerU 提供的元数据，我们将每篇论文划分为 5 个部分：引言、背景、方法、实验（含结果）以及讨论（含结论）。 将最终决策词元的最后一层注意力作为描述性图谱（如附录 L.2 所述），我们观察到如表 L.1 所示的明显的层级性偏好。 总体而言，注意力在论文后部有所增加。 然而，引言部分所受的权重高于背景部分。 我们在图 L.2 中可视化了若干示例。

paragraphs.en: Edit causality. To verify that this pattern represents the importance of each section, we perform a causal experiment. We use Codex ( gpt-5.5 , medium reasoning) to write independent, section-level edits to the markdown paper copy of 30 accepted ’26 papers with low presentation scores that PaperScorer -T scores as borderline (accept probability between 0.45 and 0.50). Each Codex instance edits one section at a time, allowing up to four sets of edits to be saved as Git commits, with feedback from PaperScorer -T received after each commit. These changes are constrained to presentation, framing, and style. We analyze the ∼ \sim 600 commits made. Details in Appendix L.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 编辑因果性。 为了验证该模式确实反映了每个部分的重要性，我们进行了一项因果实验。 我们使用 Codex（gpt-5.5，中等推理）对 30 篇被接收的 ’26 论文（展示评分较低，且被 PaperScorer-T 判定为边缘，接收概率介于 0.45 与 0.50 之间）的 Markdown 版论文撰写独立的、部分级别的编辑。 每个 Codex 智能体每次编辑一个部分，最多允许保存四组编辑作为 Git 提交，并在每次提交后接收来自 PaperScorer-T 的反馈。 这些更改仅限于展示、表述框架与风格。 我们分析了约 600 次提交。 详细内容见附录 L.2。

paragraphs.en: Our causal analysis matches the attention pattern: later sections, especially Experiments and Discussion, show the largest maximum observed changes in p accept p_{\mathrm{accept}} in Figure L.1 a. We find that the most effective edit type is section-dependent (Figure L.1 b). Formalization helps most in methodology, narrative improvements help most in the discussion and experiments, whereas substantiation in the conclusion typically hurts acceptance probability. Notably, these edits do not continuously increase p accept p_{\mathrm{accept}} , suggesting that PaperScorer -Text will only allow style edits to increase p accept p_{\mathrm{accept}} to a certain threshold outside the 0.7 high-confidence region.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的因果分析与注意力模式相吻合：在图 L.1 a 中，靠后的章节（尤其是实验和讨论）显示出 p_{\mathrm{accept}} 的最大观测变化。 我们发现最有效的编辑类型取决于具体章节（图 L.1 b）。 形式化在方法论部分帮助最大，叙事改进在讨论和实验部分帮助最大，而在结论部分进行实质论证通常会降低接受概率。 值得注意的是，这些编辑并不能持续提升 p_{\mathrm{accept}}，这表明 PaperScorer-Text 只允许风格类编辑将 p_{\mathrm{accept}} 提升到 0.7 高置信区间之外的某个阈值。

paragraphs.en: Perturbation reasoning. The attention map is descriptive rather than causal. A section may receive high last-layer attention because it carries decisive evidence, but it could also inherit importance from earlier-layer computation or from interactions across sections. We therefore complement attention with direct perturbations: if editing one section consistently changes PaperScorer -Text’s predicted acceptance probability while all other sections remain fixed, that section is more plausibly part of the model’s effective decision boundary.
paragraphs.zh: 扰动推理。 注意力图是描述性的，而非因果性的。 某个部分获得较高的最后一层注意力，可能是因为它包含决定性证据，但也可能是因为它继承了较早层计算的重要性，或来自跨部分的交互。 因此，我们用直接扰动来补充注意力分析：如果在所有其他部分保持不变的情况下，编辑某一个部分会持续改变 PaperScorer-Text 预测的录用概率，那么该部分更有可能属于模型有效决策边界的一部分。

paragraphs.en: Perturbation setup. We select 30 borderline papers whose baseline accept probabilities lie in the 0.45 0.45 – 0.50 0.50 range and spawn 5 section-specific agents per paper, one for each section family: Introduction, Background / Related Work, Methodology, Experiments / Results, and Discussion / Conclusion. The editing agent is Codex on gpt-5.5 with medium reasoning and no web search. Each agent is restricted to one section and is not allowed to change any numerical results, but it may improve framing, exposition, ordering, and technical detail within that section. Each commit the Codex agents submit is scored by our fine-tuned PaperScorer -Text, evaluated greedily at temperature 0 0 with logprobs.

paragraphs.en: Section attention trends. As noted in the main text, the section-level attention averages show a clear ordering that prioritizes later sections. The example heatmap in Figure L.2 illustrates this qualitative pattern, with attention clustering tightly around technical claims, result tables, and synthesis paragraphs, rather than the opening overview. While previous literature suggests that attention analysis alone may not definitively determine the importance of input tokens, our causal edit analysis demonstrates that the increase in acceptance likelihood follows this exact same ordering.

paragraphs.en: Perturbation protocol. For our section-level edit interventions, we select 30 accepted papers from ICLR ’26 that specifically have low presentation scores. paragraphs.en: Once the agent is satisfied, it commits the updated text with a summary statement. This process is repeated 3 more times using a naive agent given the same prompt, without knowledge of the PaperScorer output. After all commits are generated, we use PaperScorer to grade each iteration.

paragraphs.en: Impact of edits by section. The rankings of the sections by Δ ​ p accept \Delta p_{\mathrm{accept}} directly reflect the initial attention distribution, with the majority of the score improvement coming from the first edit commit. Edits to the Experiments / Results and Discussion / Conclusion yield the largest gains (5.4–6.1%), followed by Methodology (4.7%), and smaller improvements for the Introduction and Background (3.9–4.2%). Because the maximum difference between final scores across the sections differs by only 2%, we conclude that the attention weighting reflects a consistent, albeit small, effect size regarding which sections the model prioritizes. We also hypothesize that the effect size is partially due to the authors’ allocation of time. The introductions of papers are typically written quite well, as they provide the first impression for a reviewer or reader. Therefore, there may be fewer style changes that may improve the paper. On the other hand, the results themselves are typically more important than the style of reporting them, so there may be more stylistic things to update in later sections.
paragraphs.zh: 各章节编辑效果的影响。 各章节按接受率增量 Δ p accept \Delta p_{\mathrm{accept}} 的排名直接反映了初始注意力分布，其中大部分分数提升来自第一次编辑提交。 对“实验/结果与讨论/结论”章节的编辑带来最大收益（5.4–6.1%），其次是“方法论”（4.7%），而“引言”和“背景”的提升较小（3.9–4.2%）。 由于各章节最终分数之间的最大差异仅为 2%，我们得出结论：注意力加权反映了一致的、尽管较小、但体现了模型优先关注哪些章节的效应量。 我们还假设这种效应量部分归因于作者对时间的分配。 论文的引言通常写得相当好，因为它们为审稿人或读者提供了第一印象。 因此，可能存在较少的可改进论文的风格改动。 另一方面，结果本身通常比报告它们的方式更重要，因此在后续章节中可能有更多风格上的内容需要更新。

paragraphs.en: Introduction: Benefits most from adding Nuance (+11%) and Calibration (+5%). Adjusting the Narrative here decreases the score (-13%).
paragraphs.zh: 引言：从增加细微差别（+11%）和校准（+5%）中获益最多。 在此处调整叙事会降低得分（-13%）。

paragraphs.en: Background / Related Work: Improves most from Substantiation (+8%) and Narrative framing (+8%), but is penalized by added Nuance (-12%).
paragraphs.zh: 背景/相关工作：从「实证支撑」（+8%）和「叙事框架」（+8%）中获益最多，但因增加「细微差别」而受罚（-12%）。

paragraphs.en: Methodology: Only Formalization is effective (+14%), whereas all other edit types negatively impact the score.
paragraphs.zh: 方法论：只有形式化是有效的（+14%），而所有其他编辑类型都会对分数产生负面影响。

paragraphs.en: Experiments and Discussion: Narrative edits yield the highest positive returns in both the Experiments (+12%) and Discussion (+24%) sections. Crucially, attempting to introduce new Substantiation into the Discussion serves as the most detrimental edit overall (-29%), suggesting that this final section should focus on interpreting results rather than reiterating evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 实验与讨论：叙事性修改在实验（+12%）和讨论（+24%）部分均带来最高的正向收益。 至关重要的是，在讨论部分试图引入新的论证是整体上最有害的修改（-29%），这表明该最后部分应侧重于解读结果，而非重复罗列证据。

paragraphs.en: These edit success distributions reflect general paper guidelines, suggesting that our model has learned the overall structure of a paper.
